docs.title: Current Status and Issues
docs.text:
According to the auth_template_testing_status.md document, there are some ongoing issues with the testing framework:

  1. Recent Changes: The SignUpPageWithAPI component was modified to remove window.alert calls, which fixed some issues but introduced others.

  2. Failing Tests:

  3. src/tests/userAccountManagement.test.tsx

  4. src/auth_template/__tests__/userRegistrationAPI.test.tsx

  5. Root Causes:

  6. Changes in component behavior
  7. Test environment configuration issues

  8. Challenges with mocking import.meta.env

  9. Attempted Solutions:

  10. Mocking window.alert
  11. Updating tests to match new component behavior
  12. Configuring Jest and Babel for import.meta syntax
  13. Mocking the import.meta.env object

docs.title: 1. Mock Consistency Issues
docs.text:
The mock implementation of SignUpPageWithAPI in src/tests/__mocks__/SignUpPageWithAPI.tsx differs from the actual component in src/auth_template/pages/SignUpPageWithAPI.tsx:

  • The mock version includes a call to membersApi.create() after successful registration
  • The mock version includes a console.log statement for successful registration
  • The actual component has neither of these features

This inconsistency likely contributes to test failures, as tests may expect behavior that no longer exists in the actual component.

docs.title: 2. Environment Variable Handling
docs.text:
Both setup files attempt to mock import.meta.env, but with different approaches and values:

  • The root setup adds it to the window object
  • The auth template setup adds it to the global object

This inconsistency could cause tests to behave differently depending on which setup file is used.

docs.title: 3. Test Dependency on Implementation Details
docs.text:
Some tests appear to depend on implementation details that may have changed:

  • userAccountManagement.test.tsx expects the component to call membersApi.create()
  • Tests may expect specific error messages or UI elements that have changed

docs.title: Recommendations
docs.text:
To address the identified issues and ensure all tests pass:

  1. Align Mocks with Implementation:
  2. Update the mock SignUpPageWithAPI to match the actual component

  3. Ensure consistent behavior across all mocks

  4. Standardize Environment Variable Mocking:

  5. Use a consistent approach to mock import.meta.env

  6. Consider using a dedicated mock file for environment variables

  7. Update Tests to Match Current Implementation:

  8. Review and update tests that depend on removed functionality

  9. Focus on testing behavior rather than implementation details

  10. Improve Error Handling in Tests:

  11. Add more specific assertions to identify failure points

  12. Include better error messages to aid debugging

  13. Consider Test Refactoring:

  14. Move toward more integration-focused tests
  15. Reduce dependency on implementation details

docs.title: Conclusion
docs.text:
The testing framework implementation is generally well-structured but has some inconsistencies and configuration issues that need to be addressed. The main problems stem from recent changes to the SignUpPageWithAPI component and inconsistencies between mocks and actual implementations.

By aligning mocks with the current implementation, standardizing environment variable handling, and updating tests to match the current behavior, the project can achieve a stable testing environment with all tests passing.

This review serves as a milestone in the ongoing effort to maintain a robust testing framework that ensures the reliability and correctness of the codebase.

Overview
docs.text: This document outlines the updated testing strategy for the Nelson Tech platform, focusing on resolving issues with Redux and Supabase integration tests. It addresses the current blockers and provides a clear path forward for maintaining a robust testing framework.

docs.title: Current Issues
docs.text:
1. Redux Integration Tests:
  2. Synchronization issues between Redux state and component state
  3. Async operation handling in tests

  4. Duplicate mocks causing conflicts

  5. Supabase Client Initialization:

  6. Environment variable handling in tests

  7. Mock implementation inconsistencies

  8. Testing Utilities:

  9. Lack of standardized test utilities for common operations
  10. Inconsistent approach to mocking

docs.title: 1. Standardized Mock Strategy
docs.text:
To resolve the duplicate mock issues and ensure consistent behavior across tests, we've implemented:

  • Centralized Mock Files:
  • src/__mocks__/lib/supabase.ts: Mock for the Supabase module
  • src/__mocks__/lib/supabaseClient.ts: Mock for the Supabase client

  • src/__mocks__/context/SessionContext.tsx: Mock for the SessionContext

  • Mock Implementation Guidelines:

  • Each mock should have a clear, single responsibility
  • Mocks should be consistent with the actual implementation
  • Mocks should be easily configurable for different test scenarios

docs.title: 2. Environment Variable Handling
docs.text:
To address the issues with environment variables and import.meta.env:

  • Updated Jest Configuration:
  • Added support for handling import.meta.env in tests

  • Standardized environment variable mocking across all tests

  • Setup Files Enhancement:

  • Updated setupTests.ts to include mocks for browser APIs
  • Added consistent environment variable mocking

docs.title: 3. Redux Testing Approach
docs.text:
For testing Redux slices and hooks:

  • Slice Testing:
  • Test reducers directly with known inputs and expected outputs
  • Test async thunks with mocked API calls

  • Verify selectors return expected values

  • Hook Testing:

  • Use renderHook from @testing-library/react-hooks with proper Redux Provider wrapper
  • Test hook behavior in isolation from components
  • Verify state updates and side effects

docs.title: 4. Component Testing with Redux
docs.text:
For components that use Redux:

  • Test Store Setup:
  • Create a test store with the necessary reducers
  • Initialize with a known state

  • Wrap components with the Provider

  • Async Testing:

  • Use act and waitFor to handle async operations
  • Ensure state updates are complete before assertions
  • Mock Redux hooks to control behavior

docs.title: 5. Supabase Integration Testing
docs.text:
For testing components that interact with Supabase:

  • Mock Supabase Client:
  • Use a consistent mock implementation
  • Configure mock responses for different test scenarios

  • Test error handling

  • Session Management:

  • Test session initialization
  • Test authentication state changes
  • Verify proper synchronization between context and Redux

docs.title: Redux Slice Test Example
docs.text:
// contentSlice.test.ts
import contentReducer, {
  updatePageContent,
  updateSectionContent,
  changeLanguage
} from '../contentSlice';

describe('contentSlice', () => {
  it('should handle updatePageContent', () => {
    const initialState = {
      pages: { home: { title: { en: 'Home' } } },
      // other state properties
    };

    const action = updatePageContent({
      pageId: 'home',
      field: 'title',
      language: 'en',
      content: 'Updated Home'
    });

    const newState = contentReducer(initialState, action);
    expect(newState.pages.home.title.en).toBe('Updated Home');
  });

  // More tests for other actions and reducers
});

docs.title: Redux Hook Test Example
docs.text:
// useContentRedux.test.ts
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react-hooks';
import { Provider } from 'react-redux';
import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import contentReducer from '../../redux/slices/contentSlice';
import { useContentRedux } from '../useContentRedux';

const createTestStore = () => configureStore({
  reducer: { content: contentReducer }
});

const wrapper = ({ children }) => {
  const store = createTestStore();
  return <Provider store={store}>{children}</Provider>;
};

describe('useContentRedux', () => {
  it('should initialize with default content', async () => {
    const { result, waitForNextUpdate } = renderHook(() => useContentRedux(), { wrapper });

    await waitForNextUpdate();

    expect(result.current.pages).toBeDefined();
    expect(result.current.currentLanguage).toBe('en');
  });

  // More tests for other hook functionality
});

docs.title: Supabase Integration Test Example
docs.text:
// SessionContextWithRedux.test.tsx
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { Provider } from 'react-redux';
import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import authReducer from '../../redux/slices/authSlice';
import { SessionProvider } from '../SessionContext';
import TestComponent from './TestComponent';

const createTestStore = () => configureStore({
  reducer: { auth: authReducer }
});

describe('SessionContext with Redux', () => {
  it('should sync session state with Redux', async () => {
    const store = createTestStore();

    render(
      <Provider store={store}>
        <SessionProvider>
          <TestComponent />
        </SessionProvider>
      </Provider>
    );

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('session-status')).toHaveTextContent('authenticated');
      expect(store.getState().auth.isAuthenticated).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  // More tests for authentication flows
});

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Test Isolation:
  2. Each test should be independent
  3. Reset mocks and state between tests

  4. Avoid test interdependencies

  5. Mock Consistency:

  6. Use the same mock implementation across related tests
  7. Configure mocks for specific test scenarios

  8. Document mock behavior

  9. Async Testing:

  10. Always use act for state updates
  11. Use waitFor with reasonable timeouts

  12. Handle promises properly

  13. Redux Testing:

  14. Test slice behavior directly
  15. Test hooks with proper providers

  16. Verify state synchronization

  17. Error Handling:

  18. Test both success and error scenarios
  19. Verify error states are properly managed
  20. Test recovery from errors

The assistant will leverage existing infrastructure while adding intelligent capabilities for content understanding, user assistance, and community engagement.

-- Core embedding tables
CREATE TABLE content_embeddings (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    source_table TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id UUID NOT NULL,
    content_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    embedding vector(1536), -- OpenAI dimensions
    embedding_model TEXT DEFAULT 'text-embedding-ada-002',
    chunk_index INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    metadata JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

-- Conversation memory for AI assistant

    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    messages JSONB[],
    context JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),

);

    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

docs.title: 2.3 Hybrid Search Implementation
docs.text:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ai_hybrid_search(
  query_text TEXT,
  query_embedding vector(1536),
  content_types TEXT[] DEFAULT NULL,
  limit_results INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
  user_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  content_id UUID,
  content_type TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  snippet TEXT,
  relevance_score FLOAT,
  permission_check BOOLEAN
) AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH semantic_results AS (
    SELECT 
      ce.source_id,
      ce.content_type,
      ce.metadata->>'title' as title,
      ce.metadata->>'snippet' as snippet,
      1 - (ce.embedding <=> query_embedding) as semantic_score
    FROM content_embeddings ce
    WHERE 
      (content_types IS NULL OR ce.content_type = ANY(content_types))
    ORDER BY ce.embedding <=> query_embedding
    LIMIT limit_results * 2
  ),
  keyword_results AS (
    SELECT 
      e.id as source_id,
      'event' as content_type,
      e.title,
      LEFT(e.description, 200) as snippet,
      ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', e.title || ' ' || e.description), 
              plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)) as keyword_score
    FROM events e
    WHERE 
      to_tsvector('english', e.title || ' ' || e.description) @@ 
      plainto_tsquery('english', query_text)
    LIMIT limit_results * 2
  ),
  combined_results AS (
    SELECT 
      COALESCE(s.source_id, k.source_id) as content_id,
      COALESCE(s.content_type, k.content_type) as content_type,
      COALESCE(s.title, k.title) as title,
      COALESCE(s.snippet, k.snippet) as snippet,
      (COALESCE(s.semantic_score, 0) * 0.7 + 
       COALESCE(k.keyword_score, 0) * 0.3) as relevance_score
    FROM semantic_results s
    FULL OUTER JOIN keyword_results k ON s.source_id = k.source_id
  )
  SELECT 
    cr.*,
    check_user_permission(user_id, cr.content_id, cr.content_type) as permission_check
  FROM combined_results cr
  ORDER BY cr.relevance_score DESC
  LIMIT limit_results;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

docs.title: 4.1 Messaging System Integration
docs.text:
// Extend existing messaging API
class AIMessagingIntegration {
  async handleAIConversation(
    userId: string,
    message: string,
    conversationId?: string
  ): Promise<AIResponse> {
    // 1. Get user context
    const context = await this.buildUserContext(userId);

    // 2. Retrieve relevant content
    const relevantContent = await this.searchRelevantContent(message, context);

    // 3. Generate AI response
    const response = await this.generateResponse(message, relevantContent, context);

    // 4. Apply permission filters
    const filteredResponse = await this.applyPermissionFilters(response, userId);

    // 5. Store conversation
    await this.storeConversation(userId, message, filteredResponse);

    return filteredResponse;
  }
}

docs.title: 6.1 Permission-Aware Responses
docs.text:
class PermissionAwareAI {
  async filterResponse(
    response: string,
    userId: string,
    context: AIContext
  ): Promise<string> {
    // Check user permissions
    const permissions = await this.getUserPermissions(userId);

    // Filter sensitive content
    const filteredContent = await this.removeSensitiveContent(response, permissions);

    // Apply role-based restrictions
    const roleFilteredContent = await this.applyRoleRestrictions(filteredContent, userId);

    return roleFilteredContent;
  }
}

docs.title: A. Implement Response Caching
docs.text:
// src/lib/ai/cache-service.ts
export class AIResponseCache {
  private cache = new Map<string, { response: string; timestamp: number; }>();
  private readonly CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes

  generateCacheKey(prompt: string, selectedText: string = ''): string {
    return btoa(`${prompt}|${selectedText}`).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '');
  }

  get(key: string): string | null {
    const cached = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!cached) return null;

    if (Date.now() - cached.timestamp > this.CACHE_TTL) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return null;
    }

    return cached.response;
  }

  set(key: string, response: string): void {
    this.cache.set(key, { response, timestamp: Date.now() });

    // Cleanup old entries
    if (this.cache.size > 100) {
      const entries = Array.from(this.cache.entries());
      entries.sort((a, b) => a[1].timestamp - b[1].timestamp);
      entries.slice(0, 20).forEach(([key]) => this.cache.delete(key));
    }
  }
}

docs.title: B. Request Queue Management
docs.text:
// src/lib/ai/request-queue.ts
export class AIRequestQueue {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<any>> = [];
  private processing = false;
  private readonly MAX_CONCURRENT = 2;
  private activeRequests = 0;

  async enqueue<T>(requestFn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.queue.push(async () => {
        try {
          const result = await requestFn();
          resolve(result);
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error);
        }
      });

      this.processQueue();
    });
  }

  private async processQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.activeRequests >= this.MAX_CONCURRENT) return;

    const request = this.queue.shift();
    if (!request) return;

    this.processing = true;
    this.activeRequests++;

    try {
      await request();
    } finally {
      this.activeRequests--;
      this.processing = false;

      // Process next request
      if (this.queue.length > 0) {
        setTimeout(() => this.processQueue(), 100);
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: C. Streaming Response Optimization
docs.text:
// Enhanced streaming with visual feedback
export const streamAIResponse = async (
  prompt: string,
  selectedText: string,
  onChunk: (chunk: string) => void,
  onComplete: (fullResponse: string) => void
): Promise<void> => {
  const aiProvider = getAIProvider();
  if (!aiProvider) throw new Error('AI not configured');

  let fullResponse = '';

  try {
    const result = await streamText({
      model: aiProvider.getModel(),
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: getSystemPrompt() },
        { role: 'user', content: selectedText ? `${prompt}\n\n${selectedText}` : prompt }
      ],
      maxTokens: 4000,
      temperature: 0.7
    });

    // Process streaming response
    for await (const chunk of result.textStream) {
      fullResponse += chunk;
      onChunk(chunk);

      // Add small delay for better UX
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    }

    onComplete(fullResponse);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`AI streaming failed: ${error.message}`);
  }
};

// src/lib/ai/image-loader.ts
export class OptimizedImageLoader {
  private readonly imageCache = new Map<string, HTMLImageElement>();

  async loadImagesParallel(
    imageUrls: Array<{ url: string; alt: string }>,
    onProgress: (loaded: number, total: number) => void
  ): Promise<HTMLImageElement[]> {
    const loadPromises = imageUrls.map(async ({ url, alt }, index) => {
      if (this.imageCache.has(url)) {
        onProgress(index + 1, imageUrls.length);
        return this.imageCache.get(url)!;
      }

      return new Promise<HTMLImageElement>((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new Image();
        img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
        img.onload = () => {
          this.imageCache.set(url, img);
          onProgress(index + 1, imageUrls.length);
          resolve(img);
        };
        img.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${url}`));
        img.src = this.optimizeImageUrl(url);
        img.alt = alt;
      });
    });

    return Promise.all(loadPromises);
  }

  private optimizeImageUrl(url: string): string {
    // Add WebP format support and size optimization
    if (url.includes('unsplash.com')) {
      return `${url}&auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80`;
    }
    return url;
  }
}

docs.title: B. Lazy Loading Implementation
docs.text:
// src/components/LazyImage.tsx
export const LazyImage: React.FC<{
  src: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  onLoad?: () => void;
}> = ({ src, alt, className, onLoad }) => {
  const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const img = imgRef.current;
          if (img) {
            img.src = src;
            img.onload = () => {
              setIsLoaded(true);
              onLoad?.();
            };
            img.onerror = () => setError('Failed to load image');
            observer.disconnect();
          }
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '50px' }
    );

    if (imgRef.current) observer.observe(imgRef.current);

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [src, onLoad]);

  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`}>
      <img
        ref={imgRef}
        alt={alt}
        className={`transition-opacity duration-300 ${
          isLoaded ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'
        }`}
        data-src={src}
      />
      {!isLoaded && !error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gray-200 animate-pulse rounded" />
      )}
      {error && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gray-100 flex items-center justify-center">
          <span className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Image not available</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

// src/lib/ai/memory-manager.ts
export class MemoryManager {
  private memoryUsage = { ai: 0, images: 0, editor: 0 };
  private readonly MAX_MEMORY_MB = 100;

  trackAIResponse(response: string): void {
    const sizeKB = new Blob([response]).size / 1024;
    this.memoryUsage.ai += sizeKB;

    if (this.memoryUsage.ai > this.MAX_MEMORY_MB * 1024) {
      this.cleanup('ai');
    }
  }

  trackImage(imageData: any): void {
    const sizeKB = this.estimateImageSize(imageData);
    this.memoryUsage.images += sizeKB;

    if (this.memoryUsage.images > this.MAX_MEMORY_MB * 1024) {
      this.cleanup('images');
    }
  }

  private cleanup(type: 'ai' | 'images' | 'editor'): void {
    // Implement cleanup logic based on type
    console.log(`Cleaning up ${type} memory usage`);
    this.memoryUsage[type] = 0;
  }

  getMemoryReport(): typeof this.memoryUsage {
    return { ...this.memoryUsage };
  }
}

// src/lib/errors/error-handler.ts
export enum AIErrorType {
  NETWORK_ERROR = 'NETWORK_ERROR',
  API_KEY_INVALID = 'API_KEY_INVALID',
  RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED = 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
  CONTENT_FILTERED = 'CONTENT_FILTERED',
  TIMEOUT = 'TIMEOUT',
  QUOTA_EXCEEDED = 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED',
  SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE = 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'
}

export class AIError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public type: AIErrorType,
    public userMessage: string,
    public originalError?: Error,
    public retryable = false
  ) {
    super(userMessage);
    this.name = 'AIError';
  }
}

export class AIErrorHandler {
  private retryAttempts = new Map<string, number>();
  private readonly MAX_RETRIES = 3;
  private readonly RETRY_DELAY = 1000;

  async handleAPIError(error: any, context: string): Promise<AIError> {
    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
    const userMessage = this.getUserMessage(errorType);
    const retryable = this.isRetryable(errorType);

    return new AIError(errorType, userMessage, error, retryable);
  }

  async executeWithRetry<T>(
    operation: () => Promise<T>,
    operationId: string
  ): Promise<T> {
    const attempts = this.retryAttempts.get(operationId) || 0;

    try {
      const result = await operation();
      this.retryAttempts.delete(operationId); // Reset on success
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const aiError = await this.handleAPIError(error, operationId);

      if (aiError.retryable && attempts < this.MAX_RETRIES) {
        this.retryAttempts.set(operationId, attempts + 1);
        await this.delay(this.RETRY_DELAY * Math.pow(2, attempts));
        return this.executeWithRetry(operation, operationId);
      }

      throw aiError;
    }
  }

  private classifyError(error: any): AIErrorType {
    if (error.code === 'NETWORK_ERROR') return AIErrorType.NETWORK_ERROR;
    if (error.status === 401) return AIErrorType.API_KEY_INVALID;
    if (error.status === 429) return AIErrorType.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED;
    if (error.status === 403) return AIErrorType.CONTENT_FILTERED;
    if (error.name === 'TimeoutError') return AIErrorType.TIMEOUT;
    if (error.status === 402) return AIErrorType.QUOTA_EXCEEDED;
    if (error.status >= 500) return AIErrorType.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE;

    return AIErrorType.NETWORK_ERROR;
  }

  private getUserMessage(errorType: AIErrorType): string {
    const messages = {
      [AIErrorType.NETWORK_ERROR]: 'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
      [AIErrorType.API_KEY_INVALID]: 'AI service not configured. Please check your API keys.',
      [AIErrorType.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED]: 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.',
      [AIErrorType.CONTENT_FILTERED]: 'Content was filtered. Please try with different text.',
      [AIErrorType.TIMEOUT]: 'Request took too long. Please try again with shorter content.',
      [AIErrorType.QUOTA_EXCEEDED]: 'AI service quota exceeded. Please try again later.',
      [AIErrorType.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE]: 'AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.'
    };

    return messages[errorType] || 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.';
  }

  private isRetryable(errorType: AIErrorType): boolean {
    return [
      AIErrorType.NETWORK_ERROR,
      AIErrorType.TIMEOUT,
      AIErrorType.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
    ].includes(errorType);
  }

  private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }
}

// src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx
export class AIErrorBoundary extends React.Component<
  { children: React.ReactNode; onError?: (error: Error) => void },
  { hasError: boolean; error: AIError | null }
> {
  constructor(props: any) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {
    return { 
      hasError: true, 
      error: error instanceof AIError ? error : null 
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('AI Editor Error:', error, errorInfo);
    this.props.onError?.(error);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <ErrorRecoveryUI 
          error={this.state.error}
          onRetry={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })}
        />
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// src/components/ErrorRecoveryUI.tsx
export const ErrorRecoveryUI: React.FC<{
  error: AIError | null;
  onRetry: () => void;

// src/hooks/useOfflineStatus.ts
export const useOfflineStatus = () => {
  const [isOffline, setIsOffline] = useState(!navigator.onLine);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOnline = () => setIsOffline(false);
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOffline(true);

    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    };
  }, []);

  return isOffline;
};

// src/components/OfflineIndicator.tsx
export const OfflineIndicator: React.FC = () => {
  const isOffline = useOfflineStatus();

  if (!isOffline) return null;

  return (
    <div className="bg-yellow-50 border-b border-yellow-200 p-2 text-center">
      <span className="text-yellow-800 text-sm">
        You're offline. AI features are unavailable. Your work is being saved locally.
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

// src/lib/storage/draft-manager.ts
export class DraftManager {
  private readonly STORAGE_KEY = 'ai-editor-drafts';
  private readonly AUTO_SAVE_INTERVAL = 30000; // 30 seconds

  saveDraft(editorId: string, content: any[]): void {
    try {
      const drafts = this.getAllDrafts();
      drafts[editorId] = {
        content,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        version: 1
      };

      localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(drafts));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to save draft:', error);
    }
  }

  loadDraft(editorId: string): any[] | null {
    try {
      const drafts = this.getAllDrafts();
      const draft = drafts[editorId];

      if (!draft) return null;

      // Check if draft is recent (within 24 hours)
      const isRecent = Date.now() - draft.timestamp < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

      return isRecent ? draft.content : null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to load draft:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  setupAutoSave(editorId: string, getContent: () => any[]): () => void {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const content = getContent();
      if (content && content.length > 0) {
        this.saveDraft(editorId, content);
      }
    }, this.AUTO_SAVE_INTERVAL);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }

  private getAllDrafts(): Record<string, any> {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEY);
      return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }
}

// src/lib/monitoring/performance-monitor.ts
export class PerformanceMonitor {
  private metrics: Record<string, number[]> = {};

  startTiming(operation: string): string {
    const timingId = `${operation}-${Date.now()}`;
    performance.mark(`${timingId}-start`);
    return timingId;
  }

  endTiming(timingId: string, operation: string): number {
    performance.mark(`${timingId}-end`);
    performance.measure(timingId, `${timingId}-start`, `${timingId}-end`);

    const measure = performance.getEntriesByName(timingId)[0];
    const duration = measure.duration;

    if (!this.metrics[operation]) {
      this.metrics[operation] = [];
    }
    this.metrics[operation].push(duration);

    // Keep only last 100 measurements
    if (this.metrics[operation].length > 100) {
      this.metrics[operation] = this.metrics[operation].slice(-100);
    }

    return duration;
  }

  getMetrics(operation: string): {
    avg: number;
    min: number;
    max: number;
    count: number;
  } | null {
    const measurements = this.metrics[operation];
    if (!measurements || measurements.length === 0) return null;

    return {
      avg: measurements.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / measurements.length,
      min: Math.min(...measurements),
      max: Math.max(...measurements),
      count: measurements.length
    };
  }

  reportMetrics(): void {
    Object.entries(this.metrics).forEach(([operation, measurements]) => {
      const stats = this.getMetrics(operation);
      if (stats) {
        console.log(`Performance ${operation}:`, stats);
      }
    });
  }
}

// Usage in AI service
const performanceMonitor = new PerformanceMonitor();

export const callAI = async (prompt: string, selectedText?: string) => {
  const timingId = performanceMonitor.startTiming('ai-request');

  try {
    const result = await actualAICall(prompt, selectedText);
    const duration = performanceMonitor.endTiming(timingId, 'ai-request');

    if (duration > 10000) { // Log slow requests
      console.warn(`Slow AI request: ${duration}ms`);
    }

    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    performanceMonitor.endTiming(timingId, 'ai-request-error');
    throw error;
  }
};

The agent can intelligently process shared links and create structured content:

class ContentMigrationAgent {
  async processSharedUrl(url: string, description: string, contentType: string): Promise<ImportedContent> {
    // 1. Fetch and analyze content from URL
    const webContent = await this.fetchWebContent(url);

    // 2. Use LLM to extract structured data
    const prompt = `
      Extract structured information for a ${contentType} item from this content:
      URL: ${url}
      User Description: ${description}
      Content: ${webContent}

      Return structured data appropriate for: ${contentType}
    `;

    // 3. Generate appropriate content for platform
    return await this.llm.generateStructuredContent(prompt);
  }
}

docs.text:
import { StateGraph, END } from "@langchain/langgraph";
import { ChatOpenAI } from "@langchain/openai";

interface CommunitySetupState {
  setupPhase: 'discovery' | 'feature_selection' | 'content_generation' | 'import' | 'groups_creation' | 'configuration' | 'finalization';
  communityInfo: {
    name?: string;
    type?: string;
    description?: string;
    targetAudience?: string;
    vision?: string;
    goals?: string[];
  };
  selectedFeatures: {
    events: boolean;
    marketplace: boolean;
    groups: boolean;
    messaging: boolean;
    resources: boolean;
    news: boolean;
    opportunities: boolean;
  };
  contentRequests: ContentImportRequest[];
  memberInvites: MemberInvite[];
  groupRequests: GroupCreationRequest[];
  knowledgeBaseDocuments: KnowledgeBaseDocument[];
  menuConfiguration: MenuConfiguration;
  contentGenerationRequests: ContentGenerationRequest[];
  generatedContent: {
    landingPage?: string;
    menuStructure?: NavigationItem[];
    events?: any[];
    groups?: any[];
    members?: any[];
    resources?: any[];
    news?: any[];
    opportunities?: any[];
    welcomeMessages?: string[];
    customPages?: PageDefinition[];
  };
  userResponses: Record<string, string>;
  setupProgress: number;
  needsUserInput: boolean;
  conversationContext: string[];
}

class CommunitySetupGraph {
  private graph: StateGraph<CommunitySetupState>;

  constructor() {
    this.graph = new StateGraph<CommunitySetupState>({
      channels: {
        setupPhase: { reducer: (x, y) => y ?? x },
        communityInfo: { reducer: (x, y) => ({ ...x, ...y }) },
        contentRequests: { reducer: (x, y) => [...(x || []), ...(y || [])] },
        generatedContent: { reducer: (x, y) => ({ ...x, ...y }) },
        userResponses: { reducer: (x, y) => ({ ...x, ...y }) },
        setupProgress: { reducer: (x, y) => Math.max(x || 0, y || 0) },
        needsUserInput: { reducer: (x, y) => y ?? x }
      }
    });

    this.setupNodes();
    this.setupEdges();
  }

  private setupNodes() {
    // Community setup workflow nodes
    this.graph.addNode("discovery", this.discoveryPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("feature_selection", this.featureSelectionPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("menu_design", this.menuDesignPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("content_generation", this.contentGenerationPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("knowledge_base", this.knowledgeBasePhase);
    this.graph.addNode("url_import", this.urlImportPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("groups_creation", this.groupsCreationPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("configuration", this.configurationPhase);
    this.graph.addNode("finalization", this.finalizationPhase);

    // Helper nodes
    this.graph.addNode("user_input_handler", this.handleUserInput);
    this.graph.addNode("progress_tracker", this.trackProgress);
  }

  private setupEdges() {
    // Sequential setup workflow
    this.graph.addEdge("__start__", "discovery");

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "discovery",
      this.checkDiscoveryComplete,
      {
        "continue": "feature_selection",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "feature_selection",
      this.checkFeaturesSelected,
      {
        "continue": "menu_design",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "menu_design",
      this.checkMenuComplete,
      {
        "continue": "content_generation",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "content_generation", 
      this.checkContentComplete,
      {
        "continue": "knowledge_base",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "knowledge_base",
      this.checkKnowledgeBaseComplete,
      {
        "continue": "url_import",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "url_import",
      this.checkImportComplete,
      {
        "continue": "groups_creation",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addConditionalEdges(
      "groups_creation",
      this.checkGroupsComplete,
      {
        "continue": "configuration",
        "need_input": "user_input_handler"
      }
    );

    this.graph.addEdge("configuration", "finalization");
    this.graph.addEdge("user_input_handler", "progress_tracker");
    this.graph.addEdge("finalization", END);
  }

  // Core workflow phase implementations
  private async discoveryPhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    const discoveryPrompt = `
      You are a Community Setup Assistant helping someone create their new community platform.

      Current conversation context: ${state.conversationContext?.join('\n') || 'Starting fresh'}

      Ask intelligent questions to understand:
      1. Community name and purpose
      2. Target audience and size
      3. Community type (professional, hobbyist, academic, etc.)
      4. Primary goals and vision
      5. What success looks like for this community

      Be conversational, encouraging, and ask ONE question at a time.
      Make suggestions based on what you learn.
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(discoveryPrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'discovery',
      setupProgress: 20,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };
  }

  private async featureSelectionPhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    const featurePrompt = `
      Based on the community info gathered: ${JSON.stringify(state.communityInfo)}

      Recommend which features would be most valuable:

      Available features:
      - Events (gatherings, meetups, workshops)
      - Marketplace (buy/sell/trade within community)
      - Groups (focused sub-communities)
      - Messaging (direct and group chat)
      - Resources (shared documents, links, guides)
      - News (announcements, updates)
      - Opportunities (jobs, collaborations, partnerships)

      Ask about their priorities and explain how each feature would benefit their specific community type.
      Suggest a recommended starting set based on their goals.
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(featurePrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'feature_selection',
      setupProgress: 35,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };
  }

  private async groupsCreationPhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    if (!state.selectedFeatures?.groups) {
      return {
        setupPhase: 'groups_creation',
        setupProgress: 75,
        needsUserInput: false
      };
    }

    const groupsPrompt = `
      Help create initial groups for this community: ${state.communityInfo?.name}
      Community type: ${state.communityInfo?.type}

      Suggest 3-5 initial groups that would make sense for this community.
      Ask if they want to create specific groups for:
      - Different skill levels
      - Geographic regions  
      - Specific interests/topics
      - Professional roles

      Also ask about group privacy settings and if they have initial members to invite to specific groups.
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(groupsPrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'groups_creation',
      setupProgress: 75,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };
  }

  private async menuDesignPhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    const menuPrompt = `
      Design an optimal navigation menu structure for this community:
      Name: ${state.communityInfo?.name}
      Type: ${state.communityInfo?.type}
      Features: ${JSON.stringify(state.selectedFeatures)}

      Create a logical menu structure that:
      1. Makes key features easily discoverable
      2. Follows intuitive navigation patterns
      3. Supports community growth
      4. Includes essential pages (About, Contact, etc.)

      Suggest both primary navigation and footer organization.
      Ask about any custom pages they want to include.
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(menuPrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'menu_design',
      setupProgress: 40,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };
  }

  private async contentGenerationPhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    const contentPrompt = `
      Let's create initial content to populate your community: ${state.communityInfo?.name}

      I can help generate:
      - 3-5 welcome news posts to establish community tone
      - Initial events to drive engagement
      - Starter resources relevant to your audience
      - Example opportunities/marketplace items
      - Group descriptions and guidelines

      What type of initial content would be most valuable?
      Should I create sample content now, or would you prefer to add it later?

      I can also generate content based on your community's specific focus and audience.
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(contentPrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'content_generation',
      setupProgress: 50,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };
  }

  private async knowledgeBasePhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    const knowledgeBasePrompt = `
      Now let's enhance your community's AI assistant with private knowledge.

      You can upload documents that will:
      1. Train the AI to better understand your community
      2. Provide context-specific answers
      3. Remain private (not visible to users)
      4. Improve response quality over time

      Recommended knowledge base documents:
      - Community guidelines and policies
      - FAQ responses
      - Industry-specific context
      - Your organization's background
      - Common member questions and answers

      Would you like to upload any documents now, or add this later?
      I can also help you create some foundational knowledge base content.
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(knowledgeBasePrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'knowledge_base',
      setupProgress: 60,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };
  }

  private async urlImportPhase(state: CommunitySetupState): Promise<Partial<CommunitySetupState>> {
    const llm = new ChatOpenAI({ modelName: "gpt-4" });

    const importPrompt = `
      Do you have existing content you'd like to migrate to your new community?

      Simply share URLs and I can help import:
      - News articles → Community news posts
      - Event pages → Community events
      - Resource links → Resource library
      - Marketplace items → Community marketplace
      - Group descriptions → Community groups

      Just paste a URL and describe what it is, and I'll extract the relevant information
      and format it for your community platform.

      Ready to import some content, or should we skip this for now?
    `;

    const response = await llm.invoke(importPrompt);

    return {
      setupPhase: 'url_import',
      setupProgress: 70,
      needsUserInput: true,
      conversationContext: [...(state.conversationContext || []), response.content as string]
    };

docs.title: 2. Provider Abstraction with LiteLLM
docs.text:
import { LiteLLMProvider } from 'litellm';

class ProviderManager {
  private providers: Map<string, LiteLLMProvider>;
  private costTracker: CostTracker;

  constructor() {
    this.providers = new Map();
    this.setupProviders();
  }

  private setupProviders() {
    // Primary provider - OpenAI
    this.providers.set('openai', new LiteLLMProvider({
      provider: 'openai',
      apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
      model: 'gpt-4-turbo',
      maxTokens: 4000,
      temperature: 0.7
    }));

    // Secondary provider - Anthropic
    this.providers.set('anthropic', new LiteLLMProvider({
      provider: 'anthropic',
      apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
      model: 'claude-3-sonnet',
      maxTokens: 4000,
      temperature: 0.7
    }));

    // Fallback provider - Google
    this.providers.set('google', new LiteLLMProvider({
      provider: 'google',
      apiKey: process.env.GOOGLE_API_KEY,
      model: 'gemini-pro',
      maxTokens: 4000,
      temperature: 0.7
    }));

    // Local provider - Ollama
    this.providers.set('local', new LiteLLMProvider({
      provider: 'ollama',
      baseUrl: 'http://localhost:11434',
      model: 'llama3.2',
      maxTokens: 4000,
      temperature: 0.7
    }));
  }

  async callWithFallback(
    providerOrder: string[],
    messages: any[],
    options: any = {}
  ): Promise<any> {
    for (const providerName of providerOrder) {
      try {
        const provider = this.providers.get(providerName);
        if (!provider) continue;

        const startTime = Date.now();
        const response = await provider.complete(messages, options);
        const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

        // Track usage and costs
        await this.costTracker.recordUsage({
          provider: providerName,
          model: options.model || provider.defaultModel,
          inputTokens: response.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0,
          outputTokens: response.usage?.completion_tokens || 0,
          duration,
          success: true
        });

        return response;

      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`Provider ${providerName} failed:`, error.message);

        await this.costTracker.recordUsage({
          provider: providerName,
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });

        continue; // Try next provider
      }
    }

    throw new Error('All providers failed');
  }
}

import { LangfuseTracer } from "langfuse-langchain";
import { ChatOpenAI } from "@langchain/openai";

class InstrumentedLLMManager {
  private tracer: LangfuseTracer;
  private models: Map<string, ChatOpenAI>;

  constructor() {
    this.tracer = new LangfuseTracer({
      publicKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY,
      secretKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY,
      baseUrl: process.env.LANGFUSE_HOST,
      flushAt: 1 // Immediate flush for development
    });

    this.setupModels();
  }

  private setupModels() {
    this.models = new Map([
      ['gpt-4', new ChatOpenAI({
        modelName: "gpt-4-turbo",
        callbacks: [this.tracer],
        tags: ["community-assistant", "gpt-4"]
      })],
      ['claude-3', new ChatOpenAI({
        modelName: "claude-3-sonnet",
        callbacks: [this.tracer],
        tags: ["community-assistant", "claude-3"]
      })]
    ]);
  }

  async invoke(
    modelName: string,
    messages: any[],
    metadata: any = {}
  ): Promise<any> {
    const model = this.models.get(modelName);
    if (!model) throw new Error(`Model ${modelName} not found`);

    // Add metadata for better tracing
    const enrichedMetadata = {
      ...metadata,
      userId: metadata.userId,
      sessionId: metadata.sessionId,
      feature: metadata.feature || 'community-assistance',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    return await model.invoke(messages, {
      metadata: enrichedMetadata,
      tags: [`user-${metadata.userId}`, `session-${metadata.sessionId}`]
    });
  }
}

docs.title: Advanced Tracing with Custom Spans
docs.text:
import { Langfuse } from "langfuse";

class AdvancedLangfuseIntegration {
  private langfuse: Langfuse;

  constructor() {
    this.langfuse = new Langfuse({
      publicKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY,
      secretKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY,
      baseUrl: process.env.LANGFUSE_HOST
    });
  }

  async traceUserConversation(
    userId: string,
    conversationId: string,
    callback: (tracer: any) => Promise<any>
  ): Promise<any> {
    const trace = this.langfuse.trace({
      name: "user-conversation",
      userId: userId,
      sessionId: conversationId,
      metadata: {
        platform: "nelson-tech-community",
        feature: "ai-assistant",
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    });

    try {
      const result = await callback(trace);

      // Record user feedback if available
      if (result.userFeedback) {
        trace.score({
          name: "user-satisfaction",
          value: result.userFeedback.rating,
          comment: result.userFeedback.comment
        });
      }

      return result;
    } finally {
      await trace.update({
        output: result?.finalResponse,
        level: result?.error ? "ERROR" : "DEFAULT"
      });
    }
  }

  async recordAgentInteraction(
    agentType: string,
    input: string,
    output: string,
    metadata: any = {}
  ): Promise<void> {
    const generation = this.langfuse.generation({
      name: `agent-${agentType}`,
      model: metadata.model || 'unknown',
      input: input,
      output: output,
      usage: metadata.usage,
      metadata: {
        agentType,
        confidence: metadata.confidence,
        processingTime: metadata.processingTime
      }
    });

    await generation.end();
  }

  async trackTokenUsage(
    operation: string,
    inputTokens: number,
    outputTokens: number,
    cost: number,
    provider: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.langfuse.event({
      name: "token-usage",
      metadata: {
        operation,
        inputTokens,
        outputTokens,
        totalTokens: inputTokens + outputTokens,
        cost,
        provider,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    });
  }
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

class SupabaseLangfuseIntegration {
  private supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>;
  private langfuse: Langfuse;

  constructor() {
    this.supabase = createClient(
      process.env.SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!
    );
    this.langfuse = new Langfuse();
  }

  async getUserContextForAI(userId: string): Promise<any> {
    const trace = this.langfuse.trace({
      name: "user-context-retrieval",
      userId: userId
    });

    try {
      // Get user profile, preferences, and relevant content
      const [profile, preferences, recentActivity] = await Promise.all([
        this.supabase
          .from('members')
          .select('*')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .single(),
        this.supabase
          .from('user_ai_preferences')
          .select('*')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .single(),
        this.supabase
          .from('user_activity')
          .select('*')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
          .limit(10)
      ]);

      const context = {
        profile: profile.data,
        preferences: preferences.data,
        recentActivity: recentActivity.data
      };

      trace.update({
        output: context,
        metadata: {
          contextItemsRetrieved: Object.keys(context).length
        }
      });

      return context;
    } catch (error) {
      trace.update({
        level: "ERROR",
        output: { error: error.message }
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async storeAIConversation(

import { RealtimeChannel } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

class RealtimeAIAssistant {
  private channel: RealtimeChannel;
  private langfuse: Langfuse;

  constructor(supabase: any) {
    this.langfuse = new Langfuse();
    this.channel = supabase.channel('ai-assistant');
    this.setupRealtimeHandlers();
  }

  private setupRealtimeHandlers() {
    this.channel.on('ai-query', async (payload) => {
      const { userId, query, sessionId } = payload;

      const trace = this.langfuse.trace({
        name: "realtime-ai-query",
        userId: userId,
        sessionId: sessionId
      });

      try {
        // Process query through LangChain
        const response = await this.processQuery(query, { userId, sessionId });

        // Send response back via realtime
        await this.channel.send({
          type: 'ai-response',
          event: 'ai-response',
          payload: {
            sessionId,
            response: response.content,
            metadata: response.metadata
          }
        });

        trace.update({
          output: response,
          metadata: {
            responseTime: response.metadata.processingTime,
            tokensUsed: response.metadata.tokensUsed
          }
        });

      } catch (error) {
        trace.update({
          level: "ERROR",
          output: { error: error.message }
        });

        await this.channel.send({
          type: 'ai-error',
          event: 'ai-error',
          payload: {
            sessionId,
            error: 'Sorry, I encountered an error processing your request.'
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }
}

// src/lib/ai/EnhancedLLMManager.ts
import { ChatOpenAI } from "@langchain/openai";
import { LangfuseTracer } from "langfuse-langchain";

export class EnhancedLLMManager {
  private models: Map<string, ChatOpenAI>;
  private tracer?: LangfuseTracer;
  private litellmEndpoint: string;
  private langfuseEnabled: boolean;

  constructor() {
    this.litellmEndpoint = process.env.LITELLM_ENDPOINT || "http://litellm:4000";
    this.langfuseEnabled = process.env.ENABLE_LANGFUSE === "true";

    // Only initialize LangFuse if enabled
    if (this.langfuseEnabled && this.hasLangfuseConfig()) {
      this.tracer = new LangfuseTracer({
        publicKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY!,
        secretKey: process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY!,
        baseUrl: process.env.LANGFUSE_HOST!,
        flushAt: 1
      });
    }

    this.initializeModels();
  }

  private hasLangfuseConfig(): boolean {
    return !!(
      process.env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY &&
      process.env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY &&
      process.env.LANGFUSE_HOST
    );
  }

  private initializeModels() {
    const modelConfigs = [
      { name: "gpt-4", temperature: 0.1, maxTokens: 4000 },
      { name: "fast", temperature: 0.3, maxTokens: 2000 },
      { name: "claude-3-opus", temperature: 0.1, maxTokens: 4000 }
    ];

    this.models = new Map(
      modelConfigs.map(config => [
        config.name,
        new ChatOpenAI({
          modelName: config.name,
          temperature: config.temperature,
          maxTokens: config.maxTokens,
          openAIApiKey: process.env.LITELLM_MASTER_KEY,
          configuration: {
            baseURL: `${this.litellmEndpoint}/v1`,
            defaultHeaders: {
              "Authorization": `Bearer ${process.env.LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}`,
              "HTTP-Referer": process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
              "X-Title": "Nelson Tech AI Assistant"
            }
          },
          callbacks: this.tracer ? [this.tracer] : []
        })
      ])
    );
  }

  async executeWithFallback(
    modelName: string, 
    prompt: string,
    userId?: string,
    sessionId?: string
  ): Promise<string> {
    const startTime = Date.now();

    try {
      const llm = this.models.get(modelName);
      if (!llm) {
        throw new Error(`Model ${modelName} not found`);
      }

      const response = await llm.invoke(prompt, {
        metadata: { userId, sessionId }
      });

      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      // Log success metrics (only if observability is enabled)
      if (this.langfuseEnabled && this.tracer) {
        await this.logMetrics({
          type: "success",
          model: modelName,
          duration,
          tokenCount: prompt.length + response.content.length,
          userId,
          sessionId
        });
      }

      return response.content as string;

    } catch (error) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;

      // Log failure metrics (only if observability is enabled)
      if (this.langfuseEnabled && this.tracer) {
        await this.logMetrics({
          type: "failure",
          model: modelName,
          duration,
          error: error.message,
          userId,
          sessionId
        });
      }

      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async logMetrics(data: any) {
    // Store in your database for analytics
    // LangFuse automatically captures this through callbacks when enabled
    if (this.tracer) {
      await this.tracer.trace({
        name: `llm_request_${data.type}`,
        metadata: data
      });
    }
  }

  // Utility method to check if observability is enabled
  public isObservabilityEnabled(): boolean {
    return this.langfuseEnabled && !!this.tracer;
  }
}

class ProductionMonitoring {
  private langfuse: Langfuse;
  private alerts: AlertingService;

  async checkSystemHealth(): Promise<HealthStatus> {
    const metrics = await this.langfuse.getMetrics('1h');

    const health: HealthStatus = {
      status: 'healthy',
      issues: []
    };

    // Check response times
    if (metrics.averageResponseTime > this.config.responseTime.critical) {
      health.status = 'unhealthy';
      health.issues.push('High response times detected');
      await this.alerts.sendAlert('critical', 'Response time exceeded threshold');
    }

    // Check error rates
    if (metrics.errorRate > this.config.errorRate.critical) {
      health.status = 'unhealthy';
      health.issues.push('High error rate detected');
      await this.alerts.sendAlert('critical', 'Error rate exceeded threshold');
    }

    return health;
  }
}

class CostOptimizedRouting {
  private costDatabase: Map<string, ProviderCost>;

  selectOptimalProvider(
    queryComplexity: 'simple' | 'medium' | 'complex',
    requiredQuality: 'standard' | 'high' | 'premium'
  ): string {
    const costEffectiveOptions = {
      simple: {
        standard: 'google/gemini-1.5-flash',  // Cheapest
        high: 'anthropic/claude-3-haiku',     // Good balance
        premium: 'openai/gpt-4'               // Best quality
      },
      medium: {
        standard: 'anthropic/claude-3-haiku',
        high: 'openai/gpt-4-turbo',
        premium: 'openai/gpt-4'
      },
      complex: {
        standard: 'anthropic/claude-3-sonnet',
        high: 'openai/gpt-4-turbo',
        premium: 'openai/gpt-4'
      }
    };

    return costEffectiveOptions[queryComplexity][requiredQuality];
  }

  async trackMonthlyCosts(): Promise<CostReport> {
    const usage = await this.langfuse.getUsageStats('30d');

    const costsByProvider = {};
    let totalCost = 0;

    for (const [provider, stats] of Object.entries(usage.byProvider)) {
      const cost = this.calculateProviderCost(provider, stats);
      costsByProvider[provider] = cost;
      totalCost += cost;
    }

    return {
      totalCost,
      costsByProvider,
      projectedMonthlyCost: totalCost * (30 / new Date().getDate()),
      recommendations: this.generateCostOptimizations(costsByProvider)
    };
  }
}

docs.title: 2. Caching Strategy
docs.text:
class SemanticCaching {
  private redis: Redis;
  private similarityThreshold = 0.95;

  async getCachedResponse(
    query: string,
    context: any
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    const queryEmbedding = await this.generateEmbedding(query);
    const cacheKey = this.generateCacheKey(context);

    // Check for semantically similar cached responses
    const cachedQueries = await this.redis.hgetall(`cache:${cacheKey}`);

    for (const [cachedQuery, response] of Object.entries(cachedQueries)) {
      const cachedEmbedding = await this.getEmbedding(cachedQuery);
      const similarity = this.cosineSimilarity(queryEmbedding, cachedEmbedding);

      if (similarity > this.similarityThreshold) {
        await this.langfuse.event({
          name: "cache-hit",
          metadata: {
            originalQuery: query,
            cachedQuery: cachedQuery,
            similarity: similarity
          }
        });

        return response;
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  async cacheResponse(
    query: string,
    response: string,
    context: any,
    ttl: number = 3600
  ): Promise<void> {
    const cacheKey = this.generateCacheKey(context);
    await this.redis.hset(`cache:${cacheKey}`, query, response);
    await this.redis.expire(`cache:${cacheKey}`, ttl);
  }
}

# Pseudocode for Member Matching Algorithm
class MemberMatchingEngine:
    def calculate_compatibility_score(self, member_a, member_b):
        factors = {
            'skill_complementarity': 0.25,
            'geographic_proximity': 0.20,
            'interest_overlap': 0.20,
            'experience_level_match': 0.15,
            'collaboration_history': 0.10,
            'network_effects': 0.10
        }

        score = 0
        for factor, weight in factors.items():
            score += self.calculate_factor_score(

        return min(score, 1.0)

# Content Curation Algorithm Framework
class ContentCurationEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.quality_model = ContentQualityModel()
        self.relevance_model = ContentRelevanceModel()
        self.trending_detector = TrendingTopicDetector()

    def curate_feed(self, member_profile, available_content):
        scored_content = []

        for content in available_content:
            quality_score = self.quality_model.score(content)
            relevance_score = self.relevance_model.score(
                content, member_profile
            )
            recency_score = self.calculate_recency_score(content)
            social_score = self.calculate_social_signals(content)

            combined_score = (
                quality_score * 0.3 +
                relevance_score * 0.4 +
                recency_score * 0.2 +
                social_score * 0.1
            )

            scored_content.append((content, combined_score))

        return sorted(scored_content, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

    def generate_content_insights(self, content):
        return {
            'suggested_tags': self.extract_tags(content),
            'target_audience': self.identify_audience(content),
            'optimal_posting_time': self.predict_optimal_time(content),
            'engagement_prediction': self.predict_engagement(content)
        }

# Real-time AI Processing Pipeline

    def __init__(self):
        self.stream_processor = KafkaStreamProcessor()

        self.model_serving = ModelServingLayer()

            action_event.member_id, features

        # Generate real-time recommendations

        # Cache results for fast retrieval

        # Retrain models with new data

        return {

docs.title: 2. Privacy-Preserving AI Techniques
docs.text:
Federated Learning Implementation: Enable AI model training without centralizing sensitive data:

# Federated Learning Framework for Community AI
class FederatedCommunityAI:
    def __init__(self):
        self.central_model = CommunityAIModel()
        self.local_models = {}

    def train_federated_model(self, communities):
        # Each community trains locally
        for community in communities:
            local_model = self.train_local_model(community)
            self.local_models[community.id] = local_model

        # Aggregate model updates without sharing raw data
        aggregated_updates = self.aggregate_model_updates(
            self.local_models
        )

        # Update central model
        self.central_model.update_weights(aggregated_updates)

        return self.central_model

    def train_local_model(self, community):
        # Train on local community data only
        local_data = community.get_training_data()
        local_model = self.central_model.copy()
        local_model.train(local_data)

        # Return only model updates, not data
        return local_model.get_weight_updates()

Differential Privacy: Add mathematical privacy guarantees to AI outputs:

# Differential Privacy for AI Recommendations
class DifferentiallyPrivateRecommender:
    def __init__(self, epsilon=1.0):
        self.epsilon = epsilon  # Privacy budget
        self.recommender = BaseRecommender()

    def get_private_recommendations(self, user_id, k=10):
        # Get base recommendations
        base_recommendations = self.recommender.get_recommendations(
            user_id, k * 2  # Get more to account for noise
        )

        # Add calibrated noise for privacy
        noisy_scores = []
        for item, score in base_recommendations:
            noise = self.laplace_noise(1.0 / self.epsilon)
            noisy_score = score + noise
            noisy_scores.append((item, noisy_score))

        # Return top-k after adding noise
        return sorted(noisy_scores, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:k]

    def laplace_noise(self, sensitivity):
        return np.random.laplace(0, sensitivity)

// Progressive text streaming
class TextStreamer {
  async streamResponse(text: string, speed: number = 30) {
    const words = text.split(' ');
    let displayed = '';

    for (const word of words) {
      displayed += word + ' ';
      await this.updateDisplay(displayed);
      await this.delay(speed);
    }
  }
}
