docs.text:
// src/features/notifications/hooks/useNotificationsHybrid.ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '@/store/hooks';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  useNotifications,
  useNotificationsWithFilters,
  useCreateNotification,
  useMarkNotificationAsRead,
  useDeleteNotification,
} from '../api/notificationsApi';
import {
  updateFilters,
  clearFilters,
  setViewMode,
  toggleUnreadOnly,
  toggleNotificationSelection,
  selectAllNotifications,
  clearSelection,
  setSorting,
  setPage,
  setItemsPerPage,
  selectNotificationsFilters,
  selectSelectedNotifications,
  selectViewMode,
  selectShowUnreadOnly,
  selectSorting,
  selectPagination,
} from '../store/notificationsUISlice';
import { NotificationFilters, NotificationInput } from '../types';

/**
 * Hybrid hook for notifications that combines React Query for data fetching
 * with Redux for UI state management
 */
export function useNotificationsHybrid() {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // UI state from Redux
  const filters = useAppSelector(selectNotificationsFilters);
  const selectedNotifications = useAppSelector(selectSelectedNotifications);
  const viewMode = useAppSelector(selectViewMode);
  const showUnreadOnly = useAppSelector(selectShowUnreadOnly);
  const sorting = useAppSelector(selectSorting);
  const pagination = useAppSelector(selectPagination);

  // React Query for data fetching
  const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;
  const notificationsQuery = useNotificationsWithFilters(hasFilters ? filters : undefined);

  // Mutations
  const createMutation = useCreateNotification();
  const markAsReadMutation = useMarkNotificationAsRead();
  const deleteMutation = useDeleteNotification();

  // Enhanced actions with better UX
  const createNotification = async (data: NotificationInput) => {
    try {
      const result = await createMutation.mutateAsync(data);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const markAsRead = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const result = await markAsReadMutation.mutateAsync(id);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const deleteNotification = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      await deleteMutation.mutateAsync(id);
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  };

  // Filter actions (Redux)
  const updateFiltersAction = (newFilters: Partial<NotificationFilters>) => {
    dispatch(updateFilters(newFilters));
  };

  const setSearchTerm = (search?: string) => {
    updateFiltersAction({ search });
  };

  const setTypeFilter = (type?: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success') => {
    updateFiltersAction({ type });
  };

  const setReadFilter = (read?: boolean) => {
    updateFiltersAction({ read });
  };

  const clearAllFilters = () => {
    dispatch(clearFilters());
  };

  // View actions (Redux)
  const setViewModeAction = (mode: 'list' | 'compact') => {
    dispatch(setViewMode(mode));
  };

  const toggleUnreadOnlyAction = () => {
    dispatch(toggleUnreadOnly());
  };

  // Selection actions (Redux)
  const toggleSelection = (id: string) => {
    dispatch(toggleNotificationSelection(id));
  };

  const selectAll = () => {
    const allIds = notificationsQuery.data?.map(n => n.id) || [];
    dispatch(selectAllNotifications(allIds));
  };

  const clearSelectionAction = () => {
    dispatch(clearSelection());
  };

  // Sorting actions (Redux)
  const setSortingAction = (sortBy: string, sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc') => {
    dispatch(setSorting({ sortBy, sortDirection }));
  };

  // Pagination actions (Redux)
  const setPageAction = (page: number) => {
    dispatch(setPage(page));
  };

  const setItemsPerPageAction = (itemsPerPage: number) => {
    dispatch(setItemsPerPage(itemsPerPage));
  };

  // Computed values
  const totalNotifications = notificationsQuery.data?.length || 0;
  const unreadCount = notificationsQuery.data?.filter(n => !n.read).length || 0;
  const hasSelection = selectedNotifications.length > 0;

  // Client-side pagination (can be moved to server-side later)
  const paginatedNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    const notifications = notificationsQuery.data || [];
    const startIndex = (pagination.page - 1) * pagination.itemsPerPage;
    const endIndex = startIndex + pagination.itemsPerPage;
    return notifications.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  }, [notificationsQuery.data, pagination]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalNotifications / pagination.itemsPerPage);

  return {
    // Data from React Query
    notifications: notificationsQuery.data || [],
    paginatedNotifications,
    isLoading: notificationsQuery.isLoading,
    isError: notificationsQuery.isError,
    error: notificationsQuery.error,
    refetch: notificationsQuery.refetch,

    // UI state from Redux
    filters,
    selectedNotifications,
    viewMode,
    showUnreadOnly,
    sorting,
    pagination,

    // Computed values
    totalNotifications,
    unreadCount,
    hasSelection,
    totalPages,

    // Filter actions
    updateFilters: updateFiltersAction,
    setSearchTerm,
    setTypeFilter,
    setReadFilter,
    clearAllFilters,

    // View actions
    setViewMode: setViewModeAction,
    toggleUnreadOnly: toggleUnreadOnlyAction,

    // Selection actions
    toggleSelection,
    selectAll,
    clearSelection: clearSelectionAction,

    // Sorting actions
    setSorting: setSortingAction,

    // Pagination actions
    setPage: setPageAction,
    setItemsPerPage: setItemsPerPageAction,

    // Mutation actions
    createNotification,
    markAsRead,
    deleteNotification,

    // Mutation states
    isCreating: createMutation.isPending,
    createError: createMutation.error,
    isMarkingAsRead: markAsReadMutation.isPending,
    markAsReadError: markAsReadMutation.error,
    isDeleting: deleteMutation.isPending,
    deleteError: deleteMutation.error,
  };
}

/**
 * Hybrid hook for a single notification
 */
export function useNotificationHybrid(id?: string) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // React Query for data fetching
  const notificationQuery = useNotification(id);

  // Mutations
  const markAsReadMutation = useMarkNotificationAsRead();
  const deleteMutation = useDeleteNotification();

  const markAsRead = async () => {
    if (!id) throw new Error('Notification ID is required');
    return markAsReadMutation.mutateAsync(id);
  };

  const deleteNotification = async () => {
    if (!id) throw new Error('Notification ID is required');
    return deleteMutation.mutateAsync(id);
  };

  return {
    // Data from React Query
    notification: notificationQuery.data,
    isLoading: notificationQuery.isLoading,
    isError: notificationQuery.isError,
    error: notificationQuery.error,
    refetch: notificationQuery.refetch,

    // Actions
    markAsRead,
    deleteNotification,

    // Mutation states
    isMarkingAsRead: markAsReadMutation.isPending,
    markAsReadError: markAsReadMutation.error,
    isDeleting: deleteMutation.isPending,
    deleteError: deleteMutation.error,
  };
}

// src/features/notifications/components/NotificationsList/index.tsx
import { useNotificationsHybrid } from '../../hooks/useNotificationsHybrid';
import NotificationCard from './NotificationCard';
import LoadingSpinner from '@/shared/components/ui/LoadingSpinner';
import ErrorMessage from '@/shared/components/ui/ErrorMessage';

interface NotificationsListProps {
  // Optional parent data (for flexibility)
  notifications?: Notification[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: Error;
}

export default function NotificationsList({
  notifications: parentNotifications,
  loading: parentLoading,
  error: parentError
}: NotificationsListProps) {
  // Determine data source
  const useParentData = parentNotifications !== undefined;

  // Use hybrid hook only if no parent data provided
  const {
    paginatedNotifications,
    isLoading,
    error,
    viewMode,
    selectedNotifications,
    toggleSelection,
    totalPages,
    pagination,
    setPage
  } = useNotificationsHybrid();

  // Use appropriate data source
  const finalNotifications = useParentData ? parentNotifications : paginatedNotifications;
  const finalLoading = useParentData ? parentLoading : isLoading;
  const finalError = useParentData ? parentError : error;

  if (finalLoading) {
    return <LoadingSpinner />;
  }

  if (finalError) {
    return <ErrorMessage error={finalError} />;
  }

  if (!finalNotifications?.length) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-8">
        <p className="text-gray-500">No notifications found</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className={`space-y-2 ${viewMode === 'compact' ? 'space-y-1' : ''}`}>
        {finalNotifications.map(notification => (
          <NotificationCard
            key={notification.id}
            notification={notification}
            isSelected={selectedNotifications.includes(notification.id)}
            onToggleSelection={() => toggleSelection(notification.id)}
            compact={viewMode === 'compact'}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {!useParentData && totalPages > 1 && (
        <Pagination
          currentPage={pagination.page}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          onPageChange={setPage}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// src/features/notifications/hooks/__tests__/useNotificationsHybrid.test.ts
import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Provider } from 'react-redux';
import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { useNotificationsHybrid } from '../useNotificationsHybrid';
import notificationsUIReducer from '../../store/notificationsUISlice';

const createTestWrapper = () => {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: { retry: false },
      mutations: { retry: false },
    },
  });

  const store = configureStore({
    reducer: {
      notificationsUI: notificationsUIReducer,
    },
  });

  return ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <Provider store={store}>
        {children}
      </Provider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
};

describe('useNotificationsHybrid', () => {
  test('initializes with correct default state', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useNotificationsHybrid(), {
      wrapper: createTestWrapper(),
    });

    expect(result.current.notifications).toEqual([]);
    expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.selectedNotifications).toEqual([]);
    expect(result.current.viewMode).toBe('list');
  });

  test('updates filters correctly', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useNotificationsHybrid(), {
      wrapper: createTestWrapper(),
    });

    act(() => {
      result.current.setSearchTerm('test');
    });

    expect(result.current.filters.search).toBe('test');
  });
});

  4. Maintainability: Consistent patterns across features
  5. Testability: Easy to mock and test individual concerns

Follow this pattern for all new features to maintain architectural consistency!

docs.title: Admin Gallery Management System - Architecture & Design
Executive Summary
docs.text: This document outlines the comprehensive admin gallery management system design for the Nelson Tech platform. Building on the existing gallery infrastructure, this system provides administrators with powerful tools to manage galleries, photos, and user-generated content through an intuitive interface.

docs.title: Current Infrastructure Analysis
docs.text: The existing system includes: - Gallery API (galleryApi.ts) with CRUD operations - Photo API (photoApi.ts) with advanced search and metadata handling - Comprehensive type definitions supporting batch operations - Supabase backend with storage integration - Redux state management with UI slices

docs.title: Admin Gallery Endpoints
docs.text:
// Gallery Management API
interface AdminGalleryApi {
  // Gallery CRUD
  getAdminGalleries(params: {
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
    filters?: AdminGalleryFilters;
    sortBy?: string;
    sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
  }): Promise<{
    galleries: AdminGalleryView[];
    totalCount: number;
    totalPages: number;
    currentPage: number;
  }>;

  getAdminGallery(id: string): Promise<AdminGalleryView>;
  createAdminGallery(data: CreateGalleryInput): Promise<AdminGalleryView>;
  updateAdminGallery(id: string, data: UpdateGalleryInput): Promise<AdminGalleryView>;
  deleteAdminGallery(id: string): Promise<boolean>;

  // Photo Management
  getAdminGalleryPhotos(galleryId: string, params?: {
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
    filters?: AdminPhotoFilters;
  }): Promise<{
    photos: AdminPhotoView[];
    totalCount: number;
  }>;

  updateAdminPhoto(photoId: string, data: UpdatePhotoData): Promise<AdminPhotoView>;
  deleteAdminPhoto(photoId: string): Promise<boolean>;
  reorderAdminPhotos(galleryId: string, photoOrders: { id: string; order: number }[]): Promise<boolean>;
  setCoverPhoto(galleryId: string, photoId: string): Promise<boolean>;

  // Bulk Operations
  bulkUpdateGalleries(operation: BulkOperation): Promise<{
    success: string[];
    failed: Array<{ id: string; error: string }>;
  }>;

  bulkUpdatePhotos(operation: BulkOperation): Promise<{
    success: string[];
    failed: Array<{ id: string; error: string }>;
  }>;

  // Moderation
  getModerationQueue(params?: {
    entityType?: 'gallery' | 'photo';
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    items: ModerationItem[];
    totalCount: number;
  }>;

  approveModeration(itemId: string, notes?: string): Promise<boolean>;
  rejectModeration(itemId: string, notes: string): Promise<boolean>;

  // Analytics & Stats
  getGalleryAnalytics(galleryId: string, timeframe: string): Promise<GalleryAnalytics>;
  getPhotoAnalytics(photoId: string, timeframe: string): Promise<PhotoAnalytics>;
  getAdminDashboardStats(): Promise<AdminGalleryStats>;
}

docs.title: Extended Database Schema
docs.text:
-- Additional admin-specific views and functions
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW admin_galleries AS
SELECT 
  g.*,
  u.name as owner_name,
  u.email as owner_email,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gallery_photos WHERE gallery_id = g.id) as photo_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gallery_likes WHERE gallery_id = g.id) as like_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gallery_comments WHERE gallery_id = g.id) as comment_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moderation_queue WHERE entity_type = 'gallery' AND entity_id = g.id AND status = 'pending') 
    THEN 'pending'
    ELSE 'approved'
  END as moderation_status
FROM user_galleries g
LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON g.user_id = u.id;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW admin_photos AS
SELECT 
  p.*,
  g.title as gallery_title,
  u.name as uploader_name,
  u.email as uploader_email,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM moderation_queue WHERE entity_type = 'photo' AND entity_id = p.id AND status = 'pending') 
    THEN 'pending'
    ELSE 'approved'
  END as moderation_status
FROM gallery_photos p
LEFT JOIN user_galleries g ON p.gallery_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON p.user_id = u.id;

-- Admin functions for bulk operations
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_bulk_update_galleries(
  gallery_ids uuid[],
  update_data jsonb
) RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  success boolean,
  error_message text
) AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Implementation for bulk gallery updates
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

interface AdminPermissions {
  galleries: {
    view: boolean;
    create: boolean;
    edit: boolean;
    delete: boolean;
    moderate: boolean;
    bulkOperations: boolean;
  };
  photos: {
    view: boolean;
    upload: boolean;
    edit: boolean;
    delete: boolean;
    moderate: boolean;
    downloadOriginal: boolean;
  };
  users: {
    viewProfiles: boolean;
    manageGalleries: boolean;
  };
  system: {
    viewAnalytics: boolean;
    manageSettings: boolean;
    auditLog: boolean;
  };
}

// Permission middleware
const checkAdminPermission = (action: string, resource: string) => {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    const user = req.user as AuthUser;
    if (!hasAdminPermission(user, action, resource)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' });
    }
    next();
  };
};

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The Unified User Management system combines user accounts and member profiles into a single, comprehensive interface for administrators. This guide covers all features and functionality of the new system.

docs.title: 1. Unified Data View
docs.text:
• Combined Information: View user account data and member profile information in one place
  • Activity Tracking: See user activity across posts, events, and groups
  • Status Management: Easily manage user status (Active, Blocked, Archived)
  • Profile Details: Access job titles, companies, locations, and social links

docs.text:

docs.text:

  • Status Filter: Show only active, blocked, or archived users
  • Page Size: Adjust number of users displayed (10, 25, 50, 100)

docs.title: 3. User Actions Dropdown
docs.text:
Each user has an actions dropdown with the following options:

  • Edit (Default): Opens the comprehensive edit modal
  • View: Opens the user's public profile in a new tab
  • Block: Temporarily blocks user access
  • Archive: Soft-delete the user (can be restored)
  • Delete: Permanently remove the user (requires confirmation)

docs.title: 4. Bulk Operations
docs.text:
Select multiple users to perform bulk actions:

  1. Select Users: Use checkboxes to select individual users or select all
  2. Choose Action: Select from available bulk actions
  3. Apply: Execute the action on all selected users

Available bulk actions: - Activate: Set selected users to active status - Block: Block multiple users at once - Archive: Archive multiple users - Export Selected: Export only selected users to CSV - Delete: Delete multiple users (requires confirmation)

docs.title: 5. CSV Import Feature
docs.text: Import multiple users from a CSV file:

docs.text:
Name,Email,Title,Company,Location,Phone,Website,LinkedIn,Twitter,Bio
John Doe,john@example.com,Developer,Tech Corp,New York,+1234567890,https://johndoe.com,linkedin.com/in/johndoe,@johndoe,Experienced developer

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: The User Dashboard API provides a comprehensive system for users to manage their content, view analytics, and engage with the platform across all features. It integrates seamlessly with existing APIs while providing unified access to user data and operations.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Content Management: Unified view and management of all user content
  • Analytics & Insights: Detailed analytics across all content types
  • Activity Feeds: Real-time user activity tracking
  • Recommendations: AI-powered content recommendations
  • Bulk Operations: Efficient batch operations on multiple content items
  • Security & Permissions: Role-based access control and content ownership verification
  • Integration: Seamless integration with existing feature APIs

docs.title: Core APIs
docs.text:
1. Dashboard API (dashboardApi): Main dashboard functionality
  2. Content Management API (contentManagementApi): Advanced content operations
  3. Integration API (integrationApi): External service integrations
  4. Security API (dashboardSecurity): Authentication and authorization

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
import { dashboardManager } from '@/features/dashboard/api';

// Get complete dashboard overview
const overview = await dashboardManager.getOverview();

// Get user's content with filtering
const content = await dashboardManager.getContent({
  type: ['photo', 'event'],
  status: ['published'],
  featured: true
}, 1, 20);

// Get activity feed
const activity = await dashboardManager.getActivity({}, 1, 10);

// Get recommendations
const recommendations = await dashboardManager.getRecommendations(['event', 'group'], 5);

docs.title: GET /api/dashboard/overview
docs.text:
Get comprehensive dashboard overview including analytics, activity, and recommendations.

Response: 

{
  data: {
    user_id: string;
    total_content: number;
    published_content: number;
    draft_content: number;
    total_views: number;
    total_likes: number;
    total_comments: number;
    profile_completion: number;
    last_activity: string;
    content_analytics: ContentAnalytics[];
    recent_activity: ActivityItem[];
    recommendations: ContentRecommendation[];
    engagement_metrics: EngagementMetrics;
  };
  last_updated: string;
}

Example: 

const overview = await dashboardApi.getDashboardOverview();
console.log(`Profile completion: ${overview.data.profile_completion}%`);

docs.title: GET /api/dashboard/content
docs.text:
Get all user content with advanced filtering and pagination.

Parameters: - filters (ContentFilters): Filter criteria - page (number): Page number (default: 1) - limit (number): Items per page (default: 20) - includeAnalytics (boolean): Include analytics data

Response: 

{
  data: DashboardContent[];
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    total_pages: number;
    has_more: boolean;
  };
  filters_applied: ContentFilters;
}

Example: 

// Get featured photos from last month
const content = await contentManagementApi.getAllUserContent({
  filters: {
    type: ['photo'],
    featured: true,
    startDate: '2024-01-01',
    endDate: '2024-01-31'
  },
  page: 1,
  limit: 10,
  includeAnalytics: true
});

docs.title: POST /api/dashboard/content/bulk
docs.text:

Body: 

{
  content_ids: string[];
  operation: 'publish' | 'unpublish' | 'archive' | 'delete' | 'feature' | 'unfeature';
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

Response: 

{
  data: {
    success_count: number;
    error_count: number;
    errors: Array<{
      content_id: string;
      error: string;
    }>;
  };
  operation: string;
  total_processed: number;
}

Example: 

// Publish multiple photos
const result = await contentManagementApi.performBulkContentOperation({
  content_ids: ['photo1', 'photo2', 'photo3'],
  operation: 'publish'
});

{

const updated = await contentManagementApi.updateContentItem(

Parameters: - period (string): 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year' - content_types (string[]): Content types to analyze - start_date (string): Start date (ISO format) - end_date (string): End date (ISO format)

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
All dashboard endpoints require user authentication. The system automatically validates the user session and retrieves the associated member profile.

// Authentication is handled automatically by withAuth middleware
const userContext = await dashboardSecurity.getUserContext();

docs.title: Role-Based Access Control
docs.text:
The system supports multiple user roles with different permission levels:

  • user: Basic content creation and management
  • moderator: Content moderation and publishing
  • admin: Full content management and analytics
  • super_admin: Unlimited access

docs.title: Content Ownership
docs.text:
Users can only access and modify content they own, unless they have elevated permissions:

// Check content ownership
const ownership = await dashboardSecurity.verifyContentOwnership('content123', 'photo');
if (!ownership.is_owner) {
  throw new Error('Access denied');
}

docs.title: Permissions Check
docs.text:
Check specific permissions before performing operations:

// Check if user can perform bulk operations
const permissions = await dashboardSecurity.getDashboardPermissions();
if (!permissions.can_bulk_edit) {
  throw new Error('Bulk edit not allowed');
}

docs.text:
API calls are rate-limited to prevent abuse:

// Rate limiting is applied automatically
const allowed = await dashboardSecurity.checkRateLimit('overview', 50, 3600000);

Users have quotas based on their role:

// Check if user can create more content

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text:
The API uses consistent error handling across all endpoints:

try {
  const result = await dashboardApi.getDashboardOverview();
} catch (error) {
  if (error.message === 'User not authenticated') {
    // Handle authentication error
  } else if (error.message === 'Rate limit exceeded') {
    // Handle rate limiting
  } else {
    // Handle other errors
  }
}

docs.title: React Component
docs.text:
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { dashboardManager } from '@/features/dashboard/api';

const DashboardOverview: React.FC = () => {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadOverview = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await dashboardManager.getOverview();
        setOverview(data.data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load overview:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadOverview();
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Dashboard Overview</h1>
      <p>Total Content: {overview?.total_content}</p>
      <p>Profile Completion: {overview?.profile_completion}%</p>
      {/* ... rest of component */}
    </div>
  );
};

const handleBulkPublish = async (selectedIds: string[]) => {

    console.log(`Published ${result.data.success_count} items`);
    if (result.data.error_count > 0) {
      console.error('Some items failed:', result.data.errors);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Bulk operation failed:', error);
  }
};

      {analytics.map(item => (
        <div key={item.content_type}>
          <h3>{item.content_type}</h3>
          <p>Total: {item.total_count}</p>
          <p>Views: {item.view_count}</p>
          <p>Growth: {item.growth_percentage}%</p>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

docs.title: ADR-001: Component-Based Modular Design
docs.text: Status: Approved Decision: Use a component-based architecture with clear separation of concerns Rationale: - Enables reusability across different dashboard sections - Facilitates testing and maintenance - Allows for incremental feature rollout - Supports future extensibility

docs.title: ADR-002: TypeScript-First Development
docs.text: Status: Approved Decision: All dashboard components will be built with comprehensive TypeScript interfaces Rationale: - Ensures type safety across complex data structures - Improves developer experience and IDE support - Reduces runtime errors - Facilitates refactoring and maintenance

docs.title: ADR-003: React Query for Data Management
docs.text: Status: Approved Decision: Use React Query (TanStack Query) for server state management Rationale: - Provides excellent caching and synchronization - Handles loading and error states automatically - Supports optimistic updates - Integrates well with existing API patterns

docs.title: ADR-004: Supabase RLS for Security
docs.text: Status: Approved Decision: Leverage Supabase Row Level Security for data access control Rationale: - Ensures users only see their own content - Provides database-level security - Consistent with existing security model - Reduces API endpoint complexity

// App.tsx or main.tsx
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';

docs.title: Conclusion
docs.text:
The user dashboard system provides a solid foundation for content management with room for extensive customization and enhancement. The modular architecture ensures maintainability and scalability as requirements evolve.

Key benefits: - Centralized content management - Intuitive user experience - Extensible architecture - Performance optimized - Security focused

The implementation follows React and TypeScript best practices, uses efficient data fetching patterns, and provides comprehensive type safety throughout the application.

docs.title: Comprehensive Photo Gallery System - Technical Specification
Executive Summary
docs.text: This document provides a comprehensive technical specification for implementing an advanced photo gallery system within the Nelson Tech platform. The system supports polymorphic relationships, allowing galleries to be attached to multiple entity types including groups, events, news articles, companies, marketplace items, and resources.

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text:
• Multi-entity Gallery Support: Galleries can belong to users, groups, companies, events, news articles, marketplace items, and resources
  • Advanced Photo Management: Batch upload, image processing, metadata extraction, and multiple size variants
  • Admin Promotion Workflows: System for promoting user photos to featured content, homepage headers, and promotional materials
  • Dynamic Page Headers: Advanced scheduling system for page header assignments
  • Social Features: Likes, comments, sharing, and engagement tracking
  • Permission System: Granular permissions based on entity ownership and user roles

docs.text:
• Built on existing Supabase infrastructure
  • Uses Row Level Security (RLS) for data access control
  • Supports real-time updates through Supabase subscriptions
  • Image processing pipeline with multiple size variants
  • Progressive image loading with placeholders
  • Comprehensive audit logging

docs.title: 1. Enhanced Gallery Polymorphic System
docs.text:
-- Enhanced user_galleries table with polymorphic support
CREATE TABLE user_galleries (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- Ownership (polymorphic)
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  owner_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'user' CHECK (owner_type IN ('user', 'group', 'company', 'event', 'news', 'marketplace', 'resource')),
  owner_id UUID, -- References the actual entity ID

  -- Gallery metadata
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  cover_photo_id UUID, -- Self-referencing to gallery_photos

  -- Privacy and visibility
  privacy_level VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public' CHECK (privacy_level IN ('public', 'members_only', 'private')),
  visibility VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'visible' CHECK (visibility IN ('visible', 'hidden', 'archived')),

  -- Organization
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  category VARCHAR(100), -- e.g., 'event-photos', 'product-images', 'team-photos'

  -- Statistics
  photo_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  view_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_featured BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,

  -- Metadata
  tags TEXT[],
  settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}', -- Gallery-specific settings

  -- Timestamps
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),

  -- Constraints
  CONSTRAINT user_galleries_title_length CHECK (char_length(title) >= 1 AND char_length(title) <= 255),
  CONSTRAINT user_galleries_slug_format CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$'),

  -- Unique constraint for entity-specific galleries
  CONSTRAINT user_galleries_entity_unique UNIQUE (owner_type, owner_id, slug)
);

-- Index for polymorphic queries
CREATE INDEX idx_user_galleries_owner ON user_galleries(owner_type, owner_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_user_galleries_entity_slug ON user_galleries(owner_type, owner_id, slug);

docs.title: 2. Enhanced Gallery Photos Table
docs.text:
-- Enhanced gallery_photos table with comprehensive metadata
CREATE TABLE gallery_photos (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  gallery_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES user_galleries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- File information
  file_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  original_file_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mime_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

  -- Storage paths for different sizes
  storage_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- Original/main path
  thumbnail_path TEXT,
  small_path TEXT,
  medium_path TEXT,
  large_path TEXT,

  -- Generated URLs (computed or cached)
  thumbnail_url TEXT,
  small_url TEXT,
  medium_url TEXT,
  large_url TEXT,

  -- Image dimensions and processing
  width INTEGER,
  height INTEGER,
  aspect_ratio DECIMAL(10,8),
  dominant_color VARCHAR(7), -- Hex color
  placeholder_data TEXT, -- Base64 LQIP (Low Quality Image Placeholder)

  -- Photo metadata
  title VARCHAR(255),
  description TEXT,
  alt_text VARCHAR(500),
  caption TEXT,

  -- Technical metadata (EXIF)
  exif_data JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  camera_make VARCHAR(100),
  camera_model VARCHAR(100),
  focal_length VARCHAR(50),
  aperture VARCHAR(50),
  shutter_speed VARCHAR(50),
  iso_speed INTEGER,
  taken_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

  -- Location data
  location_name VARCHAR(255),
  latitude DECIMAL(10, 8),
  longitude DECIMAL(11, 8),

  -- Organization and status
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  visibility VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'visible' CHECK (visibility IN ('visible', 'hidden', 'archived')),
  processing_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (processing_status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),

  -- Engagement metrics
  view_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  like_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  comment_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  download_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

  -- Moderation and promotion
  moderation_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'approved' CHECK (moderation_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'flagged')),
  is_featured BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  featured_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  featured_by UUID REFERENCES members(id),

  -- Tags and categorization
  tags TEXT[],

  -- Timestamps
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),

  -- Constraints
  CONSTRAINT gallery_photos_file_size_check CHECK (file_size > 0 AND file_size <= 100000000), -- 100MB max
  CONSTRAINT gallery_photos_dimensions_check CHECK (width > 0 AND height > 0),
  CONSTRAINT gallery_photos_coordinates_check CHECK (
    (latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL) OR 
    (latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND 
     latitude >= -90 AND latitude <= 90 AND 
     longitude >= -180 AND longitude <= 180)
  )
);

docs.title: 3. Entity Gallery Relationships
docs.text:
-- Junction table for entity-gallery relationships
CREATE TABLE entity_galleries (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  entity_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('group', 'company', 'event', 'news', 'marketplace', 'resource', 'opportunity')),
  entity_id UUID NOT NULL,
  gallery_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES user_galleries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  relationship_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'primary' CHECK (relationship_type IN ('primary', 'secondary', 'featured', 'archive')),
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),

  -- Prevent duplicate relationships
  CONSTRAINT entity_galleries_unique UNIQUE (entity_type, entity_id, gallery_id, relationship_type)
);

-- Indexes for efficient queries
CREATE INDEX idx_entity_galleries_entity ON entity_galleries(entity_type, entity_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_entity_galleries_gallery ON entity_galleries(gallery_id);

-- Enhanced photo promotions with comprehensive workflow
CREATE TABLE photo_promotions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  photo_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES gallery_photos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  promoted_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- Promotion details
  promotion_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CHECK (promotion_type IN ('featured', 'homepage_hero', 'gallery_cover', 'event_banner', 'news_image', 'social_media', 'newsletter')),
  promotion_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (promotion_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'active', 'expired', 'cancelled')),
  priority INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

  -- Targeting and context
  target_entity_type VARCHAR(20) CHECK (target_entity_type IN ('homepage', 'event', 'news', 'group', 'company', 'marketplace', 'resource')),
  target_entity_id UUID,
  context_data JSONB DEFAULT '{}',

  -- Scheduling
  start_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  end_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  auto_expire BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  max_impressions INTEGER,

  -- Admin workflow
  reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES members(id),
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  review_notes TEXT,
  rejection_reason TEXT,
  approval_metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',

  -- Performance metrics
  impression_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  click_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  engagement_score DECIMAL(5,3) DEFAULT 0,

  -- Timestamps
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),

  -- Constraints

    (start_date IS NULL AND end_date IS NULL) OR
    (start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date > start_date)
  )
);

docs.title: 5. Dynamic Page Headers
docs.text:
-- Enhanced page headers with advanced scheduling
CREATE TABLE page_headers (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  page_slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  photo_id UUID REFERENCES gallery_photos(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,

  -- Header configuration
  title VARCHAR(255),
  subtitle VARCHAR(255),
  overlay_text TEXT,
  overlay_position VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'center' CHECK (overlay_position IN ('top', 'center', 'bottom', 'left', 'right', 'top-left', 'top-right', 'bottom-left', 'bottom-right')),
  overlay_opacity DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.7 CHECK (overlay_opacity >= 0 AND overlay_opacity <= 1),

  -- Styling options
  text_color VARCHAR(7) DEFAULT '#ffffff',
  background_color VARCHAR(7),
  blur_background BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  darken_image BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  custom_css TEXT,
  gradient_overlay VARCHAR(100), -- CSS gradient definition

  -- Priority and scheduling
  priority INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  start_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  end_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

  -- Responsive configuration
  mobile_photo_id UUID REFERENCES gallery_photos(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  tablet_photo_id UUID REFERENCES gallery_photos(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  mobile_overlay_text TEXT,
  responsive_settings JSONB DEFAULT '{}',

  -- A/B testing
  variant_name VARCHAR(100),
  test_group VARCHAR(50),
  conversion_tracking BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,

  -- Admin tracking
  created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  updated_by UUID REFERENCES members(id),
  approval_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'approved' CHECK (approval_status IN ('draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),

  -- Performance metrics
  impression_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  click_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  ctr DECIMAL(5,3) DEFAULT 0, -- Click-through rate

  -- Timestamps
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now(),

  -- Constraints
  CONSTRAINT page_headers_dates_check CHECK (
    (start_date IS NULL AND end_date IS NULL) OR
    (start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date > start_date)
  ),
  CONSTRAINT page_headers_hex_color_format CHECK (
    text_color ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$' AND
    (background_color IS NULL OR background_color ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$')
  )
);

-- Index for active headers by page
CREATE INDEX idx_page_headers_active ON page_headers(page_slug, is_active, priority DESC, created_at DESC) WHERE is_active = true;

docs.title: Entity Integration Strategy
docs.text: The system uses a flexible polymorphic relationship pattern to attach galleries to multiple entity types:

user_galleries.owner_type = 'group'
user_galleries.owner_id = group.id

docs.title: 2. Junction Table Relationships

entity_galleries.entity_type = 'event'
entity_galleries.entity_id = event.id
entity_galleries.gallery_id = gallery.id

docs.title: Polymorphic Query Patterns
docs.text:
// Get all galleries for an entity
const getEntityGalleries = async (entityType: string, entityId: string) => {
  return await supabase
    .from('user_galleries')
    .select(`
      *,
      gallery_photos(*)
    `)
    .eq('owner_type', entityType)
    .eq('owner_id', entityId);
};

// Get galleries via junction table
const getRelatedGalleries = async (entityType: string, entityId: string) => {
  return await supabase
    .from('entity_galleries')
    .select(`
      *,
      user_galleries(
        *,
        gallery_photos(*)
      )
    `)
    .eq('entity_type', entityType)
    .eq('entity_id', entityId);
};

docs.text:
// /src/features/gallery/services/imageProcessingServiceEnhanced.ts

interface ImageProcessingPipeline {
  // Size Variants
  generateSizeVariants(file: File): Promise<ProcessedImageSet>;

  // Processing Options
  sizes: {
    thumbnail: { width: 150, height: 150, crop: 'center' };
    small: { width: 400, maxHeight: 400, quality: 0.8 };
    medium: { width: 800, maxHeight: 800, quality: 0.85 };
    large: { width: 1200, maxHeight: 1200, quality: 0.9 };
    original: { preserve: true, maxWidth: 4000, quality: 0.95 };
  };

  // Advanced Features
  generatePlaceholder(file: File): Promise<string>; // LQIP (Low Quality Image Placeholder)
  extractDominantColor(file: File): Promise<string>;
  extractMetadata(file: File): Promise<PhotoMetadata>;
  detectContent(file: File): Promise<ContentAnalysis>;

  // Optimization
  optimizeForWeb(file: File, targetSize: number): Promise<File>;
  compressWithQuality(file: File, quality: number): Promise<File>;
  convertFormat(file: File, targetFormat: 'webp' | 'jpg' | 'png'): Promise<File>;
}

// Implementation
class EnhancedImageProcessingService implements ImageProcessingPipeline {
  async generateSizeVariants(file: File): Promise<ProcessedImageSet> {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    const img = await this.loadImage(file);

    const variants: ProcessedImageSet = {};

    // Generate each size variant
    for (const [sizeName, config] of Object.entries(this.sizes)) {
      const processedFile = await this.resizeImage(img, config);
      variants[sizeName] = processedFile;
    }

    return variants;
  }

  async generatePlaceholder(file: File): Promise<string> {
    // Create 20x20 low quality version for progressive loading
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 20;
    canvas.height = 20;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    const img = await this.loadImage(file);

    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 20, 20);
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.1);
  }

  async extractDominantColor(file: File): Promise<string> {
    // Use canvas to analyze pixel data and find dominant color
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 50;
    canvas.height = 50;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    const img = await this.loadImage(file);

    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 50, 50);
    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 50, 50);

    return this.calculateDominantColor(imageData.data);
  }
}

  transforms: {
    resize: '?width={width}&height={height}&resize={mode}',
    quality: '&quality={quality}',
    format: '&format={format}',
    blur: '&blur={radius}',
  },

  // URL generation helper
  generateUrl(path: string, transforms?: ImageTransforms): string {
    let url = this.baseUrl + path;

    if (transforms) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      Object.entries(transforms).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        if (value !== undefined) params.append(key, String(value));
      });

      if (params.toString()) {
        url += '?' + params.toString();
      }
    }

    return url;
  }
};

// /src/features/gallery/hooks/useEnhancedUpload.ts

interface EnhancedUploadHook {
  // Core upload functionality
  uploadFiles: (files: File[], galleryId: string, options?: UploadOptions) => Promise<UploadResult>;

  // Progress tracking
  uploadProgress: UploadProgress[];
  overallProgress: number;

  // Queue management
  queueFiles: (files: File[]) => void;
  removeFromQueue: (fileId: string) => void;
  pauseUploads: () => void;
  resumeUploads: () => void;
  cancelUploads: () => void;

  // Advanced features
  validateFiles: (files: File[]) => ValidationResult[];
  processImages: (files: File[]) => Promise<ProcessedFile[]>;
  generatePreviews: (files: File[]) => Promise<PreviewData[]>;

  // Error handling
  retryFailedUploads: () => void;
  errors: UploadError[];
  clearErrors: () => void;
}

// Implementation with polymorphic entity support
const useEnhancedUpload = (
  entityType?: EntityType, 
  entityId?: string, 
  options?: UploadHookOptions
): EnhancedUploadHook => {
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<UploadProgress[]>([]);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<UploadError[]>([]);

  const uploadFiles = async (files: File[], galleryId: string, uploadOptions?: UploadOptions) => {
    // 1. Validate files
    const validationResults = await validateFiles(files);
    const validFiles = files.filter((_, index) => validationResults[index].isValid);

    // 2. Process images
    const processedFiles = await processImages(validFiles);

    // 3. Upload with progress tracking
    const uploadPromises = processedFiles.map(async (processedFile, index) => {
      try {
        // Upload all variants
        const uploadedPaths = await uploadImageVariants(processedFile);

        // Create photo record with entity relationship
        const photoData = {
          ...processedFile.metadata,
          gallery_id: galleryId,
          ...uploadedPaths
        };

        const photo = await createPhotoRecord(photoData);

        // Create entity relationship if specified
        if (entityType && entityId) {
          await createEntityPhotoRelationship(entityType, entityId, photo.id);
        }

        return photo;
      } catch (error) {
        setErrors(prev => [...prev, { fileIndex: index, error: error.message }]);
        throw error;
      }
    });

    return await Promise.allSettled(uploadPromises);
  };

  return {
    uploadFiles,
    uploadProgress,
    overallProgress: calculateOverallProgress(uploadProgress),
    // ... other methods
  };
};

  const { photos, loading, refetch } = useModerationQueue(filters);

  const handleModerate = async (photoId: string, action: ModerationAction, reason?: string) => {
    await moderatePhoto(photoId, action, reason);
    refetch();

    await bulkModerate(selectedPhotos, action);
    setSelectedPhotos([]);
    refetch();
  };

  return (
    <ModerationContainer>
      <ModerationToolbar>
        <BulkActionsBar
          selectedCount={selectedPhotos.length}
          onBulkApprove={() => handleBulkModerate('approve')}

              )

      WHEN privacy_level = 'public' AND visibility = 'visible' THEN true
      WHEN privacy_level = 'members_only' AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL THEN true
      WHEN user_id = auth.uid() THEN true
      -- Entity-specific visibility
      WHEN owner_type = 'group' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM group_members gm 
        WHERE gm.group_id = owner_id 
        AND gm.member_id = auth.uid()
        AND gm.status = 'approved'
      )
      WHEN owner_type = 'company' THEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM company_employees ce 
        WHERE ce.company_id = owner_id 
        AND ce.member_id = auth.uid()
        AND ce.status = 'active'
      )
      ELSE false
    END
  );

-- Gallery Photos: Context-aware access control
CREATE POLICY "Enhanced photo access" ON gallery_photos
  FOR SELECT USING (
    visibility = 'visible' 
    AND moderation_status = 'approved'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM user_galleries ug 
      WHERE ug.id = gallery_id 
      -- Reuse gallery visibility logic
    )
  );

-- Admin access policies
CREATE POLICY "Admin full access" ON user_galleries
  FOR ALL USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur
      WHERE ur.user_id = auth.uid()
      AND ur.role IN ('super_admin', 'admin', 'moderator')
    )
  );

-- Entity-specific admin policies
CREATE POLICY "Group admin gallery access" ON user_galleries
  FOR ALL USING (
    owner_type = 'group' 
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM group_members gm 
      WHERE gm.group_id = owner_id 
      AND gm.member_id = auth.uid()
      AND gm.role IN ('admin', 'moderator')
    )
  );

// /src/features/gallery/middleware/gallerySecurityMiddleware.ts

interface SecurityContext {
  userId: string;
  userRoles: string[];
  entityPermissions: EntityPermissions;
}

class GallerySecurityMiddleware {
  // Entity permission checking
  async checkEntityAccess(
    entityType: EntityType, 
    entityId: string, 
    action: 'read' | 'write' | 'delete' | 'moderate',
    context: SecurityContext
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    switch (entityType) {
      case 'group':
        return this.checkGroupPermissions(entityId, action, context);
      case 'company':
        return this.checkCompanyPermissions(entityId, action, context);
      case 'event':
        return this.checkEventPermissions(entityId, action, context);
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  // Upload security validation
  async validateUpload(
    file: File, 
    galleryId: string, 
    context: SecurityContext
  ): Promise<ValidationResult> {
    const validations = [
      this.validateFileType(file),
      this.validateFileSize(file),
      this.validateImageContent(file),
      await this.validateUploadPermissions(galleryId, context),
      await this.validateStorageQuota(context.userId)
    ];

    const errors = validations
      .filter(result => !result.isValid)
      .flatMap(result => result.errors);

    return {
      isValid: errors.length === 0,
      errors,
      warnings: validations.flatMap(result => result.warnings || [])
    };
  }

  // Content moderation
  async moderateImageContent(file: File): Promise<ModerationResult> {
    // Integration with content moderation APIs
    const results = await Promise.all([
      this.checkExplicitContent(file),
      this.detectFaces(file),
      this.checkCopyright(file),
      this.scanForText(file)
    ]);

    return this.compileModerationResults(results);
  }

  // Rate limiting
  async checkRateLimit(
    userId: string, 
    action: string, 
    timeWindow: number = 3600
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const key = `rate_limit:${userId}:${action}`;
    const count = await redis.get(key);

    if (!count) {
      await redis.setex(key, timeWindow, 1);
      return true;
    }

    const currentCount = parseInt(count);
    const limits = {
      'upload': 50,
      'create_gallery': 10,
      'moderate': 100
    };

    if (currentCount >= (limits[action] || 20)) {
      return false;
    }

    await redis.incr(key);
    return true;
  }
}

// EXIF data sanitization
class ExifSanitizer {
  sanitizeMetadata(metadata: PhotoMetadata): PhotoMetadata {
    const sanitized = { ...metadata };

    // Remove potentially sensitive location data unless explicitly allowed
    if (!metadata.locationSharingConsent) {
      delete sanitized.latitude;
      delete sanitized.longitude;
      delete sanitized.location_name;
    }

    // Remove device-specific identifiers
    delete sanitized.camera_serial;
    delete sanitized.device_id;

    // Sanitize timestamp precision if required
    if (metadata.timestampPrecision === 'day') {
      sanitized.taken_at = this.roundToDay(metadata.taken_at);
    }

    return sanitized;
  }
}

// /src/features/gallery/services/galleryCacheService.ts

interface CacheStrategy {
  // Multi-level caching
  l1Cache: Map<string, any>; // In-memory cache
  l2Cache: RedisCache;       // Redis cache
  l3Cache: CDNCache;         // CDN cache

  // Cache patterns
  getCachedGallery(galleryId: string): Promise<Gallery | null>;
  setCachedGallery(gallery: Gallery, ttl?: number): Promise<void>;
  invalidateGalleryCache(galleryId: string): Promise<void>;

  // Entity-specific caching
  getEntityGalleries(entityType: EntityType, entityId: string): Promise<Gallery[]>;
  cacheEntityGalleries(entityType: EntityType, entityId: string, galleries: Gallery[]): Promise<void>;

  // Image URL caching with precomputed variants
  getCachedImageUrls(photoId: string): Promise<ImageUrls | null>;
  precomputeImageUrls(photos: Photo[]): Promise<void>;
}

// Implementation with intelligent cache invalidation
class GalleryCacheService implements CacheStrategy {
  async getCachedGallery(galleryId: string): Promise<Gallery | null> {
    // Try L1 cache first
    const l1Result = this.l1Cache.get(galleryId);
    if (l1Result) return l1Result;

    // Try L2 cache (Redis)
    const l2Result = await this.l2Cache.get(`gallery:${galleryId}`);
    if (l2Result) {
      // Populate L1 cache
      this.l1Cache.set(galleryId, l2Result);
      return l2Result;
    }

    return null;
  }

  async invalidateGalleryCache(galleryId: string): Promise<void> {
    // Invalidate all cache levels
    this.l1Cache.delete(galleryId);
    await this.l2Cache.del(`gallery:${galleryId}`);

    // Invalidate entity-specific caches
    const gallery = await this.getGalleryFromDB(galleryId);
    if (gallery?.owner_type && gallery?.owner_id) {
      await this.l2Cache.del(`entity_galleries:${gallery.owner_type}:${gallery.owner_id}`);
    }

    // Invalidate CDN cache
    await this.l3Cache.purge([
      `/api/galleries/${galleryId}`,
      `/api/galleries/${galleryId}/photos`
    ]);
  }
}

// /src/features/gallery/services/imageOptimizationService.ts

interface ImageOptimizationPipeline {
  // Progressive loading optimization
  generateProgressiveJPEG(file: File): Promise<File>;
  createWebPVariants(file: File): Promise<{ webp: File; fallback: File }>;

  // Responsive image generation
  generateResponsiveSet(file: File): Promise<ResponsiveImageSet>;

  // CDN optimization
  configureCDNHeaders(imageUrl: string): Promise<CDNConfig>;
  preloadCriticalImages(imageUrls: string[]): Promise<void>;

  // Lazy loading optimization
  generateIntersectionObserverConfig(): IntersectionObserverInit;
  prefetchNextImages(currentIndex: number, photos: Photo[]): Promise<void>;
}

// Optimized image loading component
const OptimizedImage: React.FC<{
  photo: Photo;
  size: ImageSize;
  priority?: boolean;
}> = ({ photo, size, priority = false }) => {
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);

  // Preload critical images
  useEffect(() => {
    if (priority && photo.medium_url) {
      const preloadLink = document.createElement('link');
      preloadLink.rel = 'preload';
      preloadLink.as = 'image';
      preloadLink.href = photo.medium_url;
      document.head.appendChild(preloadLink);

      return () => {
        document.head.removeChild(preloadLink);
      };
    }
  }, [priority, photo.medium_url]);

  // Intersection observer for lazy loading
  useIntersectionObserver(imgRef, {
    threshold: 0.1,
    onChange: (isIntersecting) => {
      if (isIntersecting && !loaded) {
        // Start loading the image
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = () => setLoaded(true);
        img.src = photo[`${size}_url`] || photo.url;
      }
    }
  });

  return (
    <picture ref={imgRef}>
      {/* WebP support for modern browsers */}
      {photo.webp_url && (
        <source srcSet={photo.webp_url} type="image/webp" />
      )}

      {/* Responsive srcset */}
      <img
        src={loaded ? (photo[`${size}_url`] || photo.url) : photo.placeholder_data}
        srcSet={loaded ? generateSrcSet(photo) : undefined}
        sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, (max-width: 1024px) 50vw, 33vw"
        alt={photo.alt_text || photo.title}
        loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'}
        decoding="async"
        onLoad={() => setLoaded(true)}
      />
    </picture>
  );
};

// /src/features/gallery/migration/galleryMigrationService.ts

interface MigrationService {
  // Data migration
  migrateGalleryData(): Promise<MigrationResult>;
  migratePhotoUrls(): Promise<MigrationResult>;
  migrateEntityRelationships(): Promise<MigrationResult>;

  // API migration
  migrateApiEndpoints(): Promise<void>;
  updateClientCode(): Promise<void>;

  // Rollback capabilities
  rollbackMigration(step: string): Promise<void>;
  validateMigration(): Promise<ValidationResult>;
}

// Phase-based migration approach
enum MigrationPhase {
  PREPARATION = 'preparation',
  DATABASE_SCHEMA = 'database_schema',
  DATA_MIGRATION = 'data_migration',
  API_MIGRATION = 'api_migration',
  CLIENT_MIGRATION = 'client_migration',
  VALIDATION = 'validation',
  CLEANUP = 'cleanup'
}

class GalleryMigrationService implements MigrationService {
  async executeMigration(): Promise<MigrationResult> {
    const phases = [
      this.prepareForMigration(),
      this.migrateSchema(),
      this.migrateData(),
      this.migrateAPIs(),
      this.updateClients(),
      this.validateSystem(),
      this.cleanup()
    ];

    const results = [];

    for (const phase of phases) {
      try {
        const result = await phase;
        results.push(result);

        // Log progress
        console.log(`Migration phase completed:`, result);

        // Checkpoint for potential rollback
        await this.createCheckpoint(result.phase);

      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Migration failed at phase:`, error);
        await this.rollbackToLastCheckpoint();
        throw error;
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      phases: results,
      completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
}

docs.text: This comprehensive photo gallery system specification provides a robust, scalable, and secure foundation for implementing advanced gallery functionality across the Nelson Tech platform. The system's polymorphic design allows for seamless integration with all entity types while maintaining data integrity and performance.

All errors return a consistent format:

docs.title: HTTP Status Codes
docs.text:
• 200 - Success
  • 201 - Created
  • 400 - Bad Request (validation errors)
  • 401 - Unauthorized (authentication required)
  • 403 - Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
  • 404 - Not Found
  • 413 - Payload Too Large (file size exceeded)
  • 422 - Unprocessable Entity (invalid file type)
  • 429 - Too Many Requests (rate limited)
  • 500 - Internal Server Error

Code Description Recoverable Retry NETWORK_ERROR Connection issues Yes Yes UNAUTHORIZED Authentication required Yes No FORBIDDEN Insufficient permissions No No FILE_TOO_LARGE File exceeds size limit Yes No INVALID_FILE_TYPE Unsupported file format Yes No TOO_MANY_FILES File count limit exceeded Yes No UPLOAD_FAILED Upload operation failed Yes Yes GALLERY_NOT_FOUND Gallery doesn't exist No No STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED Storage limit reached No No

docs.text:
API requests are rate limited to prevent abuse:

  • General API: 1000 requests per hour per user
  • Upload Operations: 100 uploads per hour per user
  • Batch Operations: 10 batch operations per hour per user

Rate limit headers are included in responses: 

X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 999
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1642248600

// src/config/validation.ts
import { z } from 'zod';

const envSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'staging', 'production']),
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: z.string().url(),
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: z.string().min(1),
  SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: z.string().min(1),
  NEXT_PUBLIC_GALLERY_MAX_FILE_SIZE: z.string().transform(Number),

  SENTRY_DSN: z.string().url().optional(),
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CDN_URL: z.string().url().optional(),
});

export const validateConfig = () => {
  try {
    return envSchema.parse(process.env);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Invalid environment configuration:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
};

export const config = validateConfig();

docs.text:
1. Create Supabase Project 

    # Install Supabase CLI
npm install -g supabase

# Login to Supabase

ALTER TABLE photo_likes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Create RLS policies (already included in migrations)

CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_galleries_user_id ON user_galleries(user_id);
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_galleries_privacy ON user_galleries(privacy_level);
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_galleries_created ON user_galleries(created_at DESC);

// cloudflare-workers/image-transform.js
export default {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);

    // Image transformation parameters
    const width = url.searchParams.get('w');
    const quality = url.searchParams.get('q') || '85';
    const format = url.searchParams.get('f') || 'auto';

    // Build CloudFlare Image Resizing URL
    const imageUrl = `https://your-project.supabase.co${url.pathname}`;
    const transformedUrl = `https://cdn.your-domain.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=${width},quality=${quality},format=${format}/${imageUrl}`;

    return fetch(transformedUrl, {
      headers: request.headers,
      cf: {
        cacheEverything: true,
        cacheTtl: 86400 // 24 hours
      }
    });
  }
};

// middleware.ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  // Handle CORS
  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new NextResponse(null, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': process.env.CORS_ORIGINS || '*',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS',
        'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
        'Access-Control-Max-Age': '86400',
      },
    });
  }

  // Security headers
  const response = NextResponse.next();
  response.headers.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
  response.headers.set('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
  response.headers.set('X-XSS-Protection', '1; mode=block');
  response.headers.set('Referrer-Policy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');

  return response;
}

docs.title: Caching Strategy
docs.text:
// lib/cache.ts
import { Redis } from '@upstash/redis';

const redis = new Redis({
  url: process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL!,
  token: process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN!,
});

export class CacheManager {
  static async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    try {
      const data = await redis.get(key);
      return data ? JSON.parse(data as string) : null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache get error:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  static async set(key: string, value: any, ttl = 3600): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await redis.setex(key, ttl, JSON.stringify(value));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache set error:', error);
    }
  }

  static async invalidate(pattern: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const keys = await redis.keys(pattern);
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        await redis.del(...keys);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Cache invalidation error:', error);
    }
  }
}

// Usage in API
export const getCachedGalleries = async (filters: any) => {
  const cacheKey = `galleries:${JSON.stringify(filters)}`;

  let galleries = await CacheManager.get(cacheKey);
  if (!galleries) {
    galleries = await fetchGalleriesFromDB(filters);
    await CacheManager.set(cacheKey, galleries, 1800); // 30 minutes
  }

  return galleries;
};

docs.title: Database Connection Pooling
docs.text:
// lib/db-pool.ts
import { Pool } from 'pg';

const pool = new Pool({
  host: process.env.DB_HOST,
  port: parseInt(process.env.DB_PORT || '5432'),
  database: process.env.DB_NAME,
  user: process.env.DB_USER,
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD,
  max: 20,
  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
  connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000,
});

export const query = async (text: string, params?: any[]) => {
  const start = Date.now();
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    const result = await client.query(text, params);
    const duration = Date.now() - start;

    if (duration > 1000) {
      console.warn(`Slow query (${duration}ms):`, text);
    }

    return result;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
};

// lib/sentry.ts
import * as Sentry from '@sentry/nextjs';

Sentry.init({
  dsn: process.env.SENTRY_DSN,
  environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
  tracesSampleRate: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 0.1 : 1.0,
  integrations: [
    new Sentry.Integrations.Http({ tracing: true }),
    new Sentry.Integrations.Postgres(),
  ],
  beforeSend(event) {
    // Filter out sensitive data
    if (event.exception) {
      const error = event.exception.values?.[0];
      if (error?.stacktrace?.frames) {
        error.stacktrace.frames = error.stacktrace.frames.filter(
          frame => !frame.filename?.includes('node_modules')
        );
      }
    }
    return event;
  },
});

export const captureError = (error: Error, context?: any) => {
  Sentry.withScope(scope => {
    if (context) {
      scope.setContext('additional', context);
    }
    Sentry.captureException(error);
  });
};

// lib/performance.ts
export class PerformanceMonitor {
  static startTimer(name: string) {
    performance.mark(`${name}-start`);
  }

  static endTimer(name: string) {
    performance.mark(`${name}-end`);
    performance.measure(name, `${name}-start`, `${name}-end`);

    const measure = performance.getEntriesByName(name)[0];
    if (measure.duration > 1000) {
      console.warn(`Slow operation: ${name} took ${measure.duration}ms`);
    }

    return measure.duration;
  }

  static async measureAsync<T>(name: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    this.startTimer(name);
    try {
      const result = await fn();
      return result;
    } finally {
      this.endTimer(name);
    }
  }
}

// Usage
const uploadPhoto = async (file: File) => {
  return PerformanceMonitor.measureAsync('photo-upload', async () => {
    // Upload logic here
  });

docs.text:
// scripts/cleanup-orphaned-files.ts
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export async function cleanupOrphanedFiles() {
  // Get all file paths from storage
  const { data: files } = await supabase.storage
    .from('gallery-photos')
    .list('', { limit: 10000 });

  // Get all photo records from database
  const { data: photos } = await supabase
    .from('gallery_photos')
    .select('storage_path, original_path, large_path, medium_path, small_path, thumbnail_path');

  // Find files not referenced in database
  const referencedPaths = new Set();
  photos?.forEach(photo => {
    [photo.storage_path, photo.original_path, photo.large_path, 
     photo.medium_path, photo.small_path, photo.thumbnail_path]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .forEach(path => referencedPaths.add(path));
  });

  const orphanedFiles = files?.filter(file => 
    !referencedPaths.has(file.name)
  ) || [];

  // Delete orphaned files
  if (orphanedFiles.length > 0) {
    const { error } = await supabase.storage
      .from('gallery-photos')
      .remove(orphanedFiles.map(f => f.name));

    if (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting orphaned files:', error);
    } else {
      console.log(`Deleted ${orphanedFiles.length} orphaned files`);
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Health Checks
docs.text:
// lib/health-check.ts
export interface HealthStatus {
  status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy';
  checks: Record<string, {
    status: 'ok' | 'warning' | 'error';
    message?: string;
    responseTime?: number;
  }>;
}

export async function performHealthCheck(): Promise<HealthStatus> {
  const checks: HealthStatus['checks'] = {};

  // Database check
  try {
    const start = Date.now();
    const { data } = await supabase.from('user_galleries').select('id').limit(1);
    checks.database = {
      status: 'ok',
      responseTime: Date.now() - start
    };
  } catch (error) {
    checks.database = {
      status: 'error',
      message: 'Database connection failed'
    };
  }

  // Storage check
  try {
    const start = Date.now();
    const { data } = await supabase.storage.from('gallery-photos').list('', { limit: 1 });
    checks.storage = {
      status: 'ok',
      responseTime: Date.now() - start
    };
  } catch (error) {
    checks.storage = {
      status: 'error',
      message: 'Storage connection failed'
    };
  }

  // Overall status
  const hasErrors = Object.values(checks).some(check => check.status === 'error');
  const hasWarnings = Object.values(checks).some(check => check.status === 'warning');

  return {
    status: hasErrors ? 'unhealthy' : hasWarnings ? 'degraded' : 'healthy',
    checks
  };
}

docs.title: Gesture Support
docs.text:
Touch gestures for enhanced mobile experience:

// Swipe detection for image navigation
const useSwipeGesture = (onSwipeLeft: () => void, onSwipeRight: () => void) => {
  const [touchStart, setTouchStart] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [touchEnd, setTouchEnd] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const minSwipeDistance = 50;

  const onTouchStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    setTouchEnd(null);
    setTouchStart(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
    setTouchEnd(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    if (!touchStart || !touchEnd) return;

    const distance = touchStart - touchEnd;
    const isLeftSwipe = distance > minSwipeDistance;
    const isRightSwipe = distance < -minSwipeDistance;

    if (isLeftSwipe) onSwipeLeft();
    if (isRightSwipe) onSwipeRight();
  };

  return { onTouchStart, onTouchMove, onTouchEnd };
};

docs.title: Pull-to-Refresh
docs.text:
Native-like pull-to-refresh functionality:

const usePullToRefresh = (onRefresh: () => void) => {
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [pullDistance, setPullDistance] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let startY = 0;
    let currentY = 0;

    const handleTouchStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    };

    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      currentY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      const distance = currentY - startY;

      if (distance > 0 && window.scrollY === 0) {
        setPullDistance(Math.min(distance, 100));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      if (pullDistance > 60) {
        setIsRefreshing(true);
        onRefresh();
      }
      setPullDistance(0);
    };

    // Add event listeners
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchStart);
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleTouchStart);
      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      document.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [pullDistance, onRefresh]);

  return { isRefreshing, pullDistance, setIsRefreshing };
};

docs.title: Lazy Loading Strategy
docs.text:
Efficient lazy loading for mobile:

const useLazyLoading = () => {
  const [isIntersecting, setIsIntersecting] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setIsIntersecting(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      {
        rootMargin: '100px', // Start loading 100px before visible
        threshold: 0.1
      }
    );

    if (ref.current) {
      observer.observe(ref.current);
    }

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return { ref, isIntersecting };
};

docs.title: Adaptive Loading
docs.text:
Network-aware loading strategies:

const useNetworkAware = () => {
  const [networkInfo, setNetworkInfo] = useState({
    effectiveType: '4g',
    downlink: 10,
    saveData: false
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const connection = (navigator as any).connection;
    if (connection) {
      setNetworkInfo({
        effectiveType: connection.effectiveType,
        downlink: connection.downlink,
        saveData: connection.saveData
      });

      const updateConnection = () => {
        setNetworkInfo({
          effectiveType: connection.effectiveType,
          downlink: connection.downlink,
          saveData: connection.saveData
        });
      };

      connection.addEventListener('change', updateConnection);
      return () => connection.removeEventListener('change', updateConnection);
    }
  }, []);

  // Adjust quality based on network
  const getImageQuality = () => {
    if (networkInfo.saveData || networkInfo.effectiveType === 'slow-2g') {
      return 'thumbnail';
    }
    if (networkInfo.effectiveType === '2g' || networkInfo.effectiveType === '3g') {
      return 'small';
    }
    return 'medium';
  };

  return { networkInfo, getImageQuality };
};

docs.title: Offline Support
docs.text:
Basic offline functionality:

const useOfflineQueue = () => {
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(navigator.onLine);
  const [uploadQueue, setUploadQueue] = useState<PhotoUploadInput[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOnline = () => setIsOnline(true);
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOnline(false);

    window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
    };
  }, []);

  const queueUpload = (input: PhotoUploadInput) => {
    if (isOnline) {
      uploadPhoto(input);
    } else {
      setUploadQueue(prev => [...prev, input]);
      showOfflineMessage();
    }
  };

  const processQueue = async () => {
    if (isOnline && uploadQueue.length > 0) {
      for (const input of uploadQueue) {
        try {
          await uploadPhoto(input);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to upload queued photo:', error);
        }
      }
      setUploadQueue([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOnline) {
      processQueue();
    }
  }, [isOnline]);

  return { isOnline, queueUpload, uploadQueue };
};

Comprehensive error handling with user-friendly notifications.

import { GalleryErrorHandler } from '@/features/gallery/utils/errorHandler';

// Parse and handle errors
try {
  await uploadPhoto(file);
} catch (error) {
  const galleryError = GalleryErrorHandler.parseError(error, 'UPLOAD');
  GalleryErrorHandler.showError(galleryError);
}

// Show notifications
GalleryErrorHandler.showSuccess('Upload completed!');
GalleryErrorHandler.showWarning('Some files were skipped');

  () => uploadPhoto(file),
  3, // max retries

  success: successfulUploads,
  failed: failedUploads

docs.title: Custom Error Handling
docs.text:
import { GalleryErrorHandler } from '@/features/gallery/utils/errorHandler';

function CustomUpload() {
  const handleUpload = async (files: File[]) => {
    try {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(
        files.map(file => uploadPhoto(file))
      );

      const successful = results
        .filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled')
        .map(r => (r as PromiseFulfilledResult<Photo>).value);

      const failed = results
        .filter(r => r.status === 'rejected')
        .map(r => ({ error: (r as PromiseRejectedResult).reason }));

      GalleryErrorHandler.handleBatchErrors({ 
        success: successful, 
        failed 
      });

    } catch (error) {
      GalleryErrorHandler.showError(error, 'UPLOAD');
    }
  };

  return (
    <input
      type="file"
      multiple
      onChange={(e) => handleUpload(Array.from(e.target.files || []))}
    />
  );
}

docs.title: Photo Gallery System Database Schema Documentation
Overview
docs.text: The Photo Gallery System provides a comprehensive platform for user-generated photo galleries with admin promotion workflows and page header management. The system supports multiple privacy levels, advanced metadata storage, engagement features, and sophisticated admin controls.

docs.title: user_galleries
docs.text:
User-owned photo collections with privacy controls and organization features.

Key Features: - User-specific photo collections - Privacy levels: public, members_only, private - Visibility controls: visible, hidden, archived - Featured gallery support - Automatic photo count tracking - Tag-based categorization - Unique slug generation for SEO-friendly URLs

Important Fields: - cover_photo_id: Self-referencing to set gallery cover image - privacy_level: Controls who can view the gallery - slug: User-specific URL slug (unique per user) - photo_count: Automatically maintained count - view_count: Gallery engagement tracking

docs.title: gallery_photos
docs.text:
Individual photos with comprehensive metadata and engagement features.

Key Features: - Complete EXIF data storage - Multiple image sizes (original, thumbnail, medium) - Location data with GPS coordinates - Advanced engagement metrics - Moderation workflow - Featured photo promotion - Tag-based organization

Technical Metadata: - Camera information (make, model, settings) - Image dimensions and file size - Processing status tracking - Storage path management

Engagement Features: - View, like, and comment counting - Featured photo designation - Admin moderation status

docs.title: photo_promotions
docs.text:
Admin workflow for promoting photos to featured positions.

Promotion Types: - featured: General featured photos - homepage_hero: Main homepage banner - gallery_cover: Gallery cover images - event_banner: Event-specific banners - news_image: News article images

Workflow Features: - Approval workflow with admin review - Scheduling with start/end dates - Priority ordering - Context-specific promotions - Metrics tracking (impressions, clicks)

docs.title: page_headers
docs.text:
Dynamic page header assignment system with responsive support.

Key Features: - Page-specific header images - Overlay text with positioning - Responsive image support (mobile, tablet variants) - Scheduling and priority system - Custom styling options - Color and opacity controls

docs.title: photo_likes
docs.text:
User engagement through photo likes.

Features: - One like per user per photo - Automatic count updates - Engagement tracking

docs.title: photo_comments
docs.text:
Threaded comment system for photos.

Features: - Nested comment support (replies) - Content moderation - Edit tracking - Character limits (2000 max)

docs.title: photo_tags & gallery_tags
docs.text:
Junction tables connecting photos/galleries to the central tags system.

Features: - Reusable tag system integration - Tag usage tracking - Contributor attribution - Automatic tag count updates

docs.text:
members (users)

docs.title: RLS Policies
docs.text:
The system implements Row Level Security (RLS) policies for all tables:

  1. Groups Visibility:
  2. Public groups: Viewable by everyone
  3. Secret groups: Only visible to members

  4. Group creators can update/delete their groups

  5. Member Management:

  6. Anyone can view members of public groups
  7. Only members can view members of secret groups
  8. Users can join open groups

  9. Group admins can manage all members

docs.text:
The system consists of 5 main tables:

  1. menu_containers - Defines different menu types (main, footer, sidebar, etc.)
  2. menu_items - Hierarchical menu items with self-referencing relationships
  3. menu_permissions - Role-based access control for menu visibility
  4. menu_audit_log - Complete audit trail for all menu changes
  5. menu_item_translations - Internationalization support

docs.text:

  • ✅ Drag-and-drop reordering with materialized paths
  • ✅ Role-based permissions system
  • ✅ Complete audit trail with change tracking
  • ✅ Internationalization support
  • ✅ Menu validation and integrity checks

  • ✅ Export/import functionality

  • ✅ Comprehensive TypeScript types
