docs.title: menu_containers
docs.text:
Contains definitions for different menu types and their configuration.

CREATE TABLE menu_containers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    type menu_type NOT NULL, -- 'main', 'footer', 'sidebar', 'mobile', 'admin'
    title VARCHAR(200),
    description TEXT,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    max_depth INTEGER DEFAULT 3,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    updated_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id)
);

docs.title: menu_items
docs.text:
Hierarchical structure for menu items with efficient querying support.

CREATE TABLE menu_items (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    menu_container_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES menu_containers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    parent_id UUID REFERENCES menu_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    -- Content
    title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    subtitle VARCHAR(300),
    description TEXT,
    url VARCHAR(1000),
    icon VARCHAR(100),
    image_url VARCHAR(1000),

    -- Behavior
    item_type menu_item_type DEFAULT 'link', -- 'link', 'dropdown', 'divider', 'button', 'custom'
    target VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '_self',
    is_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    is_visible BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
    requires_auth BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,

    -- Hierarchy
    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    depth_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    path TEXT, -- Materialized path for efficient queries

    -- Extensibility
    custom_properties JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
    css_classes VARCHAR(500),
    data_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}',

    -- Metadata
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    updated_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id)
);

import { DragDropContext, Droppable, Draggable } from 'react-beautiful-dnd';

function DraggableMenuTree() {
  const { menuTree, reorderItems } = useMenuTree({
    container_name: 'main-navigation'
  });

  const handleDragEnd = (result: DropResult) => {
    if (!result.destination) return;

    const { source, destination } = result;

    // Build reorder request
    const request: ReorderMenuItemsRequest = {
      menu_container_id: 'container-uuid',
      parent_id: destination.droppableId === 'root' ? null : destination.droppableId,
      item_orders: calculateNewOrder(menuTree, source, destination)
    };

    reorderItems(request);
  };

  return (
    <DragDropContext onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}>
      <Droppable droppableId="root">
        {(provided) => (
          <div ref={provided.innerRef} {...provided.droppableProps}>
            {menuTree.map((item, index) => (
              <DraggableMenuItem key={item.id} item={item} index={index} />
            ))}
            {provided.placeholder}
          </div>
        )}
      </Droppable>
    </DragDropContext>
  );
}

docs.title: Admin Menu Manager
docs.text:
import { useMenuTree, useMenuItem, useBulkMenuOperations } from '../hooks/useMenu';

function MenuAdminPanel() {
  const { menuTree, reorderItems } = useMenuTree({
    container_name: 'main-navigation'
  });
  const { bulkDelete, bulkUpdate } = useBulkMenuOperations();

  const handleBulkAction = (action: string, selectedIds: string[]) => {
    switch (action) {
      case 'delete':
        bulkDelete(selectedIds);
        break;
      case 'enable':
        bulkUpdate(selectedIds.map(id => ({
          id,
          changes: { is_enabled: true }
        })));
        break;
      case 'disable':
        bulkUpdate(selectedIds.map(id => ({
          id,
          changes: { is_enabled: false }
        })));
        break;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="menu-admin-panel">
      <MenuTreeEditor menuTree={menuTree} onReorder={reorderItems} />
      <BulkActionToolbar onAction={handleBulkAction} />
    </div>
  );
}

docs.title: Recommended Architecture for Dynamic Menu System
Navigation Menu Tables
docs.text:
-- Main navigation structure
CREATE TABLE navigation_menus (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  menu_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, -- 'main', 'footer', 'admin', 'user'
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Individual navigation items
CREATE TABLE navigation_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  menu_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES navigation_menus(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  parent_id UUID REFERENCES navigation_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT,
  icon TEXT, -- Lucide icon name or emoji
  description TEXT,
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  required_roles TEXT[], -- Array of required roles
  required_features TEXT[], -- Array of required feature toggles
  target_blank BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  css_classes TEXT,
  metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Navigation permissions and visibility rules
CREATE TABLE navigation_permissions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  navigation_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES navigation_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  permission_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'role', 'feature', 'custom'
  permission_value TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_required BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

// Navigation filtering based on features
const filterNavigationByFeatures = (
  items: NavigationItem[],
  enabledFeatures: string[]
): NavigationItem[] => {
  return items.filter(item => {
    if (!item.required_features?.length) return true;
    return item.required_features.every(feature => 
      enabledFeatures.includes(feature)
    );
  }).map(item => ({
    ...item,
    children: item.children ? filterNavigationByFeatures(item.children, enabledFeatures) : []
  }));
};

    return item.required_roles.some(role => userRoles.includes(role));
  });
};

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This document outlines the comprehensive security enhancements implemented for the menu management system. The security system follows the principle of least privilege and provides multiple layers of protection.

docs.title: 1. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
docs.text:
The menu system implements a hierarchical RBAC system with the following roles:

  • superadmin: Full access to all menu operations
  • admin: Standard administrative access
  • menu_manager: Specialized menu management role
  • menu_editor: Limited menu editing capabilities
  • content_editor: Content-focused menu operations
  • auditor: Read-only access to audit logs

docs.title: Permission Actions
docs.text:
• read: View menu management interface
  • create: Create new menu items
  • update: Modify existing menu items
  • delete: Remove menu items (with cascade)
  • toggle: Enable/disable menu items
  • manage_visibility: Control menu visibility settings
  • manage_permissions: Modify menu permissions
  • view_audit_logs: Access audit trail
  • bulk_operations: Perform bulk actions
  • export: Export menu structures

docs.title: Visibility Levels
docs.text:
• public: Visible to all users
  • authenticated: Visible to logged-in users only
  • admin: Visible to administrators only
  • role_based: Visible to users with specific roles

docs.title: Basic Toggle Implementation
docs.text:
const MyMenuManager = () => {
  const [menuItems, setMenuItems] = useState<MenuItem[]>([]);

  const handleToggle = async (itemId: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      const success = await menuToggleApi.toggleMenuItem(itemId, enabled);
      if (success) {
        setMenuItems(prev => prev.map(item => 
          item.id === itemId ? { ...item, is_enabled: enabled } : item
        ));
      }
      return success;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {menuItems.map(item => (
        <MenuItemToggle
          key={item.id}
          item={item}
          onToggle={handleToggle}
          showLabel={true}
          confirmCritical={true}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

docs.title: Bulk Operations Implementation
docs.text:
const MyBulkMenuManager = () => {
  const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const handleBulkToggle = async (itemIds: string[], enabled: boolean) => {
    const result = await menuToggleApi.bulkToggleMenuItems(itemIds, enabled, true);

    // Update state based on successful operations
    const successfulIds = result.operations
      .filter(op => op.success)
      .map(op => op.id);

    setMenuItems(prev => prev.map(item => 
      successfulIds.includes(item.id) 
        ? { ...item, is_enabled: enabled }
        : item
    ));

    return result.operations;
  };

  return (
    <BulkToggleToolbar
      items={menuItems}
      selectedItems={selectedItems}
      onSelectionChange={setSelectedItems}
      onBulkToggle={handleBulkToggle}
      showCascade={true}
    />
  );
};

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
This implementation provides a comprehensive conversation deletion system for the messaging feature with the following capabilities:

  • Single conversation deletion with confirmation modal
  • Bulk conversation deletion with selection UI
  • Keyboard shortcuts for delete operations
  • Proper loading states and error handling
  • Archive functionality as an alternative to deletion
  • Success/error notifications with user feedback

docs.title: 1. DeleteConversationModal Component
docs.text:
Location: /src/features/messaging/components/DeleteConversationModal/index.tsx

A specialized confirmation modal for conversation deletion that: - Handles both single and bulk deletion modes - Shows conversation details and deletion consequences - Provides clear warning about the action being irreversible - Displays proper loading states during deletion - Uses consistent styling with existing UI components

Key Features: - Displays conversation titles being deleted - Shows warning about deletion being user-specific (other participants retain access) - Handles loading states with disabled buttons - Proper error handling with user feedback

docs.title: 2. Enhanced ConversationsList Component

UI/UX Improvements: - Delete buttons appear on hover to maintain clean interface - Bulk selection mode with visual feedback - Select all/clear selection functionality - Escape key to cancel bulk selection - Loading states for all deletion operations

Location: /src/features/messaging/api/messagingApi.real.ts

docs.title: Messaging System Fix - Foreign Key Constraint Resolution
Problem Summary
docs.text:
The messaging system was experiencing two critical issues:

  1. Foreign Key Constraint Violation: conversations_created_by_fkey error when creating messages
  2. Error: Key (created_by)=(257de888-bc42-405a-b499-d34634486c7f) is not present in table "users"

  3. Root cause: Database tables referenced auth.users but frontend used member IDs

  4. Infinite Recursion Policy Error: infinite recursion detected in policy for relation "conversation_participants"

  5. Root cause: Circular references in Row Level Security policies

docs.title: Root Cause Analysis
docs.text: The messaging system had inconsistent foreign key references: - Some tables referenced auth.users(id) - Frontend code used member IDs from members table - Policies created circular dependencies causing infinite recursion

docs.title: 1. Database Schema Fixes (20250819000006_fix_messaging_complete.sql)
docs.text:
Foreign Key Updates: - conversations.created_by → now references members(id) - conversation_participants.user_id → now references members(id) - messages.sender_id → now references members(id) - message_reactions.user_id → now references members(id)

Policy Fixes: - Removed circular references in conversation_participants policies - Updated policies to use explicit JOINs with members table - Fixed infinite recursion by avoiding self-referential queries

Function Updates: - get_unread_message_count() → now works with current user's member ID - mark_conversation_as_read() → simplified parameter signature - create_direct_conversation() → already fixed in previous migration

docs.title: 2. Frontend API Fixes (messagingApi.real.ts)
docs.text:
Added utility method: 

private async getCurrentMemberId(): Promise<string> {
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) throw new Error('User not authenticated');

  const { data: member } = await supabase
    .from('members')
    .select('id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .single();

  if (!member) throw new Error('User does not have a member profile');
  return member.id;
}

Updated all methods to use member IDs: - getConversations() - uses member ID for participant filtering - getConversation() - checks member participation - createConversation() - uses member ID as creator - getMessages() - verifies member participation - sendMessage() - uses member ID as sender - updateMessage() - verifies member ownership - deleteMessage() - verifies member ownership - markConversationAsRead() - uses updated function signature - getUnreadCount() - uses updated function signature

      {error && (
        <ErrorAlert 
          error={error} 
          onDismiss={clearError}
        />
      )}
      {/* Your component content */}
    </div>
  );
}

docs.title: 3. API Error Handling
docs.text:
import { logAndSanitizeError } from '@/utils/errorSanitization';

async function apiFunction() {
  try {
    const response = await supabase.from('table').select();
    if (response.error) throw response.error;
    return response.data;
  } catch (error) {
    const sanitized = logAndSanitizeError(error, 'API Context');
    throw new Error(sanitized.userMessage);
  }
}

docs.title: Error Handling with Retry
docs.text:
import { useErrorHandling } from '@/hooks/useErrorHandling';

function ComponentWithRetry() {
  const { 
    error, 
    isRetrying, 
    handleError, 
    retry, 
    clearError,
    canRetry 
  } = useErrorHandling({
    context: 'Data Loading',
    autoRetry: true,
    maxRetries: 3
  });

  const fetchData = async () => {
    // Your data fetching logic
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    retry(fetchData);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {error && (
        <ErrorAlert
          error={error}
          onRetry={canRetry ? handleRetry : undefined}
          onDismiss={clearError}
          isRetrying={isRetrying}
          canRetry={canRetry}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

docs.title: Form Error Handling
docs.text:
import { useFormErrors } from '@/hooks/useErrorHandling';
import { FieldError } from '@/components/ui/ErrorAlert';

function MyForm() {
  const { 
    errors, 
    setFieldError, 
    clearFieldError, 
    hasError,
    getError 
  } = useFormErrors();

  const handleSubmit = async (formData) => {
    try {
      await submitForm(formData);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.field) {
        setFieldError(err.field, err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <input 
        name="email"
        onChange={() => clearFieldError('email')}
      />
      <FieldError error={getError('email')} />

      <input 
        name="password"
        onChange={() => clearFieldError('password')}
      />
      <FieldError error={getError('password')} />
    </form>
  );
}

docs.title: Authentication Errors
docs.text:
• Invalid credentials → User-friendly login error
  • Session expired → Clear session expiry message
  • Email not confirmed → Verification reminder

docs.title: Database Errors
docs.text:
• Connection issues → "Service temporarily unavailable"
  • Not found → "Item not found"
  • Permission denied → "Access denied"

docs.title: Upload Errors
docs.text:
• File too large → Size limit message with specific limits
  • Invalid type → Allowed types list
  • Storage full → Storage limit reached message

docs.title: 1. Always Use Context
docs.text:
Provide meaningful context for better debugging:

// Good
logAndSanitizeError(error, 'User Profile - Update Avatar');

// Bad
logAndSanitizeError(error, 'Error');

docs.title: 2. Don't Re-throw Raw Errors
docs.text:
Always sanitize before re-throwing:

// Good
catch (error) {
  const sanitized = logAndSanitizeError(error, context);
  throw new Error(sanitized.userMessage);
}

// Bad
catch (error) {
  throw error; // Exposes internal details
}

docs.title: 3. Use Appropriate Error Components
docs.text:
• ErrorAlert - For major errors that need user attention
  • InlineError - For form field validation
  • FieldError - For specific form field errors
  • ErrorToast - For temporary notifications

docs.title: 4. Provide Actionable Messages
docs.text:
Error messages should tell users what they can do:

// Good: "File is too large. Please choose a file smaller than 10MB."
// Bad: "File size exceeds maximum limit."

docs.title: API Wrapper Pattern
docs.text:
class ApiService {
  private async request(endpoint: string, options: RequestInit) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(endpoint, options);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      }
      return response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      const sanitized = logAndSanitizeError(error, `API - ${endpoint}`);
      throw new Error(sanitized.userMessage);
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Hook Pattern
docs.text:
function useDataFetching(url: string) {
  const { error, handleError, clearError } = useSimpleError('Data Fetching');
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData()
      .then(setData)
      .catch(handleError);
  }, [url]);

  return { data, error, clearError };
}

docs.title: Migration Checklist
docs.text:
When updating existing error handling:

  • Replace console.error with logAndSanitizeError
  • Update error display to use new components
  • Add meaningful context strings
  • Test error scenarios to ensure no sensitive info exposed
  • Verify debug information still available in logs
  • Update tests to expect sanitized messages

docs.title: Finding Errors in Logs
docs.text:
1. Use the debug ID from user reports
  2. Search logs for the debug ID
  3. Full error context will be available in server logs

docs.title: Error Code Reference
docs.text:
• AUTH_* - Authentication related
  • DB_* - Database operations
  • UPLOAD_* - File upload issues
  • API_* - General API errors
  • VAL_* - Validation errors
  • GEN_* - Generic/unknown errors

docs.title: Support
docs.text: For questions about error handling implementation: 1. Check existing patterns in codebase 2. Review this guide and audit report 3. Test error scenarios thoroughly 4. Ensure no sensitive information is exposed

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This guide provides step-by-step instructions for migrating existing Redux-based features to the hybrid Redux + React Query architecture.

docs.title: Phase 1: Analysis
docs.text:
• Identify all state in the Redux slice
  • Categorize state as server data vs UI state
  • Map all async thunks to potential React Query hooks
  • Identify cross-component UI state dependencies

docs.title: Phase 2: Implementation
docs.text:
• Create React Query hooks for data fetching
  • Create new UI-only Redux slice
  • Build hybrid hook combining both
  • Update components to use hybrid hook
  • Remove old Redux slice

docs.title: Phase 3: Testing
docs.text:
• Test data fetching and caching
  • Verify UI state management
  • Check error handling
  • Validate optimistic updates
  • Performance benchmarking

docs.title: Migration Steps
docs.text:
Step 1: Create React Query Hooks 

// src/features/companies/hooks/useCompanyQueries.ts
export const companyQueryKeys = {
  all: ['companies'] as const,
  lists: () => [...companyQueryKeys.all, 'list'] as const,
  list: (filters?: CompanyFilters) => [...companyQueryKeys.lists(), { filters }] as const,
  details: () => [...companyQueryKeys.all, 'detail'] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...companyQueryKeys.details(), id] as const,
};

export function useCompanies(filters?: CompanyFilters) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: companyQueryKeys.list(filters),
    queryFn: () => companiesApi.getAll(filters),
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export function useCompany(id?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: companyQueryKeys.detail(id!),
    queryFn: () => companiesApi.getById(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}

Step 2: Create UI Redux Slice 

// src/features/companies/store/companiesUISlice.ts
interface CompaniesUIState {
  filters: CompanyFilters;
  selectedCompanyIds: string[];
  viewMode: 'grid' | 'list';
  sortBy: 'name' | 'industry' | 'size';
}

const companiesUISlice = createSlice({
  name: 'companiesUI',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setFilters: (state, action) => {
      state.filters = action.payload;
    },
    toggleCompanySelection: (state, action) => {
      // Selection logic
    }
  }
});

Step 3: Create Hybrid Hook 

// src/features/companies/hooks/useCompaniesHybrid.ts
export function useCompaniesHybrid() {
  // React Query
  const filters = useAppSelector(selectCompanyFilters);
  const { data: companies, isLoading } = useCompanies(filters);

  // Redux UI State
  const selectedIds = useAppSelector(selectSelectedCompanies);
  const viewMode = useAppSelector(selectViewMode);

  // Actions
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const updateFilters = useCallback((filters) => {
    dispatch(setFilters(filters));
  }, [dispatch]);

  return {
    companies,
    isLoading,
    selectedIds,
    viewMode,
    updateFilters,
    // ... other actions
  };
}

docs.title: Pattern 1: Filter State Migration
docs.text:
// Before: Mixed in Redux
const eventsSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'events',
  initialState: {
    events: [],
    filters: { category: '', date: '' },
    filteredEvents: []
  },
  reducers: {
    setEvents: (state, action) => {
      state.events = action.payload;
      state.filteredEvents = applyFilters(state.events, state.filters);
    },
    setFilters: (state, action) => {
      state.filters = action.payload;
      state.filteredEvents = applyFilters(state.events, state.filters);
    }
  }
});

// After: Separated concerns
// UI Slice - Only filters
const eventsUISlice = createSlice({
  name: 'eventsUI',
  initialState: { filters: { category: '', date: '' } },
  reducers: {
    setFilters: (state, action) => {
      state.filters = action.payload;
    }
  }
});

// React Query - Data with filters
function useFilteredEvents() {
  const filters = useAppSelector(selectEventFilters);
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['events', filters],
    queryFn: () => eventsApi.getAll(filters)
  });
}

docs.text:
// Keep selections in Redux (UI state)
const selectionSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'selection',
  initialState: {
    selectedIds: new Set<string>()
  },
  reducers: {
    toggleSelection: (state, action) => {
      const id = action.payload;
      if (state.selectedIds.has(id)) {
        state.selectedIds.delete(id);
      } else {
        state.selectedIds.add(id);
      }
    }
  }
});

// Combine with React Query data
function useSelectableItems() {
  const { data: items } = useItems();
  const selectedIds = useAppSelector(selectSelectedIds);

  const selectedItems = items?.filter(item => 
    selectedIds.includes(item.id)
  );

  return { items, selectedItems, selectedIds };
}

docs.title: Performance Metrics
docs.text:
Track these metrics before and after migration:

  1. Initial Load Time
  2. Time to first meaningful paint

  3. Time to interactive

  4. Data Fetching

  5. Number of API calls
  6. Cache hit rate

  7. Background refetch frequency

  8. Memory Usage

  9. Redux store size
  10. React Query cache size

  11. Component re-renders

  12. User Interactions

  13. Filter response time
  14. Selection state updates
  15. Form submission time

Use the performance benchmark utility: 

import { benchmark } from '@/utils/performanceBenchmark';

// Before migration
benchmark.start('redux-filter-update');
dispatch(setFilters(newFilters));
dispatch(fetchFilteredData());
benchmark.end('redux-filter-update');

// After migration
benchmark.start('hybrid-filter-update');
dispatch(setFilters(newFilters)); // Instant UI update
// React Query automatically refetches
benchmark.end('hybrid-filter-update');

// Compare results
const improvement = benchmark.compare(
  'redux-filter-update',
  'hybrid-filter-update'
);
console.log(`Performance improved by ${improvement.improvement}%`);

docs.title: Rollback Plan
docs.text:
If issues arise during migration:

  1. Feature flags: Use feature flags to toggle between old and new implementations
  2. Gradual rollout: Migrate one component at a time
  3. A/B testing: Run both versions in parallel for comparison
  4. Quick revert: Keep old Redux slices until new implementation is stable

docs.title: Success Criteria
docs.text: Migration is complete when: - [ ] All server data fetched via React Query - [ ] Redux only contains UI state - [ ] No duplicate data between Redux and React Query - [ ] Performance metrics show improvement - [ ] All tests passing - [ ] No increase in bundle size > 10%

docs.title: Hybrid Pattern Guide - React Query + Redux Architecture
📖 Overview
docs.text: The Nelson Tech Community platform uses a Hybrid Architecture that combines React Query for server state management with Redux for UI-only state management. This pattern provides the best of both worlds: efficient server state handling with predictable UI state management.

docs.title: Core Principle: Separation of Concerns
docs.text:
┌─────────────────┬─────────────────┐
│   SERVER STATE  │    UI STATE     │
├─────────────────┼─────────────────┤
│  React Query    │     Redux       │
│                 │                 │
│ • Data fetching │ • Filters       │
│ • Caching       │ • View modes    │
│ • Mutations     │ • Selections    │
│ • Loading states│ • Sort orders   │
│ • Error handling│ • Pagination    │
└─────────────────┴─────────────────┘

docs.title: Why This Pattern?
docs.text:
• React Query: Optimized for server state with built-in caching, background updates, and error handling
  • Redux: Predictable UI state management with time-travel debugging and persistence
  • Clear Boundaries: No confusion about where state belongs
  • Performance: Each tool optimized for its specific use case

docs.title: 📁 File Structure
docs.text:
Every feature follows this consistent structure:

src/features/{feature-name}/
├── api/
│   └── {feature}Api.ts          # API layer (used by React Query)
├── store/
│   └── {feature}UISlice.ts      # Redux UI-only slice
├── hooks/
│   └── use{Feature}Hybrid.ts    # Hybrid hook combining both
├── components/
│   └── ...                      # Feature components
└── types/
    └── index.ts                 # TypeScript types

docs.title: 1. API Layer ({feature}Api.ts)
docs.text:
The API layer provides methods for server operations:

// src/features/events/api/eventsApi.ts
export const eventsApi = {
  async getAll(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<Event[]> {
    // Implementation
  },

  async getById(id: string): Promise<Event | null> {
    // Implementation
  },

  async create(data: Partial<Event>): Promise<Event> {
    // Implementation
  },

  async update(id: string, data: Partial<Event>): Promise<Event> {
    // Implementation
  },

  async delete(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // Implementation
  }
};

docs.title: 2. UI Slice ({feature}UISlice.ts)
docs.text:
Redux slice for UI-only state:

// src/features/events/store/eventsUISlice.ts
import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { RootState } from '@/store';

export interface EventFilters {
  search?: string;
  types?: string[];
  dateRange?: string;
}

export interface EventsUIState {
  filters: EventFilters;
  selectedEventId: string | null;
  viewMode: 'grid' | 'list';
  sortBy: 'date' | 'title';
  sortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

const initialState: EventsUIState = {
  filters: {},
  selectedEventId: null,
  viewMode: 'grid',
  sortBy: 'date',
  sortOrder: 'desc',
};

const eventsUISlice = createSlice({
  name: 'eventsUI',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    updateFilters: (state, action: PayloadAction<Partial<EventFilters>>) => {
      state.filters = { ...state.filters, ...action.payload };
    },
    clearFilters: (state) => {
      state.filters = {};
    },
    setSelectedEvent: (state, action: PayloadAction<string | null>) => {
      state.selectedEventId = action.payload;
    },
    setViewMode: (state, action: PayloadAction<'grid' | 'list'>) => {
      state.viewMode = action.payload;
    },
    setSortBy: (state, action: PayloadAction<'date' | 'title'>) => {
      state.sortBy = action.payload;
    },
    setSortOrder: (state, action: PayloadAction<'asc' | 'desc'>) => {
      state.sortOrder = action.payload;
    },
  },
});

export const {
  updateFilters,
  clearFilters,
  setSelectedEvent,
  setViewMode,
  setSortBy,
  setSortOrder,
} = eventsUISlice.actions;

// Selectors
export const selectEventFilters = (state: RootState) => state.eventsUI.filters;
export const selectSelectedEventId = (state: RootState) => state.eventsUI.selectedEventId;
export const selectEventsViewMode = (state: RootState) => state.eventsUI.viewMode;
export const selectEventsSortBy = (state: RootState) => state.eventsUI.sortBy;
export const selectEventsSortOrder = (state: RootState) => state.eventsUI.sortOrder;

export default eventsUISlice.reducer;

docs.title: 3. Hybrid Hook (use{Feature}Hybrid.ts)
docs.text:
The hybrid hook combines React Query and Redux:

// src/features/events/hooks/useEventsHybrid.ts
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '@/hooks/reduxHooks';
import { eventsApi } from '../api/eventsApi';
import {
  selectEventFilters,
  selectSelectedEventId,
  selectEventsViewMode,
  selectEventsSortBy,
  selectEventsSortOrder,
  updateFilters,
  clearFilters,
  setSelectedEvent,
  setViewMode,
  setSortBy,
  setSortOrder,
} from '../store/eventsUISlice';
import { Event } from '../types';
import { queryKeys } from '@/config/queryClient';

export function useEventsHybrid() {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // UI state from Redux
  const filters = useAppSelector(selectEventFilters);
  const selectedEventId = useAppSelector(selectSelectedEventId);
  const viewMode = useAppSelector(selectEventsViewMode);
  const sortBy = useAppSelector(selectEventsSortBy);
  const sortOrder = useAppSelector(selectEventsSortOrder);

  // React Query for server state
  const eventsQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.eventsWithFilters(filters),
    queryFn: () => eventsApi.getAll(filters),
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes
  });

  // Get single event
  const getEvent = (id: string) => {
    return useQuery({
      queryKey: queryKeys.event(id),
      queryFn: () => eventsApi.getById(id),
      enabled: !!id,
    });
  };

  // Mutations
  const createEvent = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (data: Partial<Event>) => eventsApi.create(data),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.events });
    },
  });

  const updateEvent = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, data }: { id: string; data: Partial<Event> }) =>
      eventsApi.update(id, data),
    onSuccess: (_, { id }) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.events });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.event(id) });
    },
  });

  const deleteEvent = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => eventsApi.delete(id),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.events });
    },
  });

  // UI actions
  const setSearchTerm = (search?: string) => {
    dispatch(updateFilters({ search }));
  };

  const setEventTypes = (types?: string[]) => {
    dispatch(updateFilters({ types }));
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    dispatch(clearFilters());
  };

  // Sort events based on UI state
  const sortedEvents = [...(eventsQuery.data || [])].sort((a, b) => {
    let comparison = 0;

    switch (sortBy) {
      case 'date':
        comparison = new Date(a.date || '').getTime() - new Date(b.date || '').getTime();
        break;
      case 'title':
        comparison = (a.title || '').localeCompare(b.title || '');
        break;
    }

    return sortOrder === 'asc' ? comparison : -comparison;
  });

  return {
    // Data from React Query
    events: sortedEvents,
    isLoading: eventsQuery.isLoading,
    error: eventsQuery.error,

    // UI state from Redux
    filters,
    selectedEventId,
    viewMode,
    sortBy,
    sortOrder,

    // Actions for UI state
    setSearchTerm,

    resetFilters,
    setSelectedEvent: (id: string | null) => dispatch(setSelectedEvent(id)),

export default function EventsList({

  loading: parentLoading,
  error: parentError 
}: EventsListProps) {
  const useParentData = parentEvents !== undefined;

  const { events, isLoading, error } = useEventsHybrid();

  const finalEvents = useParentData ? parentEvents : events;
  const finalLoading = useParentData ? parentLoading : isLoading;
  const finalError = useParentData ? parentError : error;

export function useFeatureHybrid() {
  // Redux UI state
  const filters = useAppSelector(selectFilters);

  // React Query server state  
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: queryKeys.featureWithFilters(filters),
    queryFn: () => featureApi.getAll(filters)
  });

  return {
    // Data
    items: query.data || [],
    isLoading: query.isLoading,
    error: query.error,

    // UI state
    filters, viewMode, sortBy,

    // Actions
    setSearchTerm, setViewMode,

    // Queries & Mutations
    getItem, createItem, updateItem
  };
}

docs.title: Feature Development Guide
docs.text: This guide explains how to develop new features in the Nelson Tech platform using our feature-based architecture.

docs.title: Feature Structure
docs.text:
Each feature is self-contained in the /src/features directory with this structure:

src/features/[feature-name]/
├── api/              # API calls and data fetching
├── components/       # React components
├── hooks/            # Custom React hooks
├── store/            # Redux slices and actions
├── types/            # TypeScript type definitions
├── utils/            # Helper functions
├── __tests__/        # Feature tests
└── index.ts          # Public API exports

docs.title: 1. Plan with SPARC
docs.text:
Start by planning your feature using SPARC methodology:

# Define requirements
npx claude-flow sparc run spec-pseudocode "Define [feature] requirements"

# Design architecture
npx claude-flow sparc run architect "Design [feature] architecture"

docs.title: 2. Create Feature Structure
docs.text:
# Create feature directory
mkdir -p src/features/[feature-name]/{api,components,hooks,store,types,utils,__tests__}

# Create index file
touch src/features/[feature-name]/index.ts

docs.title: 3. Define Types
docs.text:
Start with TypeScript types in types/index.ts:

// Domain types
export interface Feature {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  // ... other properties
}

// API types
export interface CreateFeatureRequest {
  name: string;
  // ... other fields
}

// State types
export interface FeatureState {
  items: Feature[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

docs.title: 4. Create API Layer
docs.text:
Implement API calls in api/featureApi.ts:

import { supabase } from '@/shared/lib/supabase';
import { Feature, CreateFeatureRequest } from '../types';

export const featureApi = {
  async getAll(): Promise<Feature[]> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('features')
      .select('*');

    if (error) throw error;
    return data;
  },

  async create(request: CreateFeatureRequest): Promise<Feature> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('features')
      .insert(request)
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) throw error;
    return data;
  }
};

docs.title: 5. Create Hooks
docs.text:
Implement React Query hooks in hooks/useFeatureQueries.ts:

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { featureApi } from '../api/featureApi';

const QUERY_KEY = ['features'];

export function useFeatures() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: QUERY_KEY,
    queryFn: featureApi.getAll
  });
}

export function useCreateFeature() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: featureApi.create,
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: QUERY_KEY });
    }
  });
}

docs.title: 6. Create Redux Slice (if needed)
docs.text:
For complex state management, create store/featureSlice.ts:

import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { FeatureState } from '../types';

const initialState: FeatureState = {
  items: [],
  loading: false,
  error: null
};

export const featureSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'feature',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setItems: (state, action: PayloadAction<Feature[]>) => {
      state.items = action.payload;
    },
    setLoading: (state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) => {
      state.loading = action.payload;
    }
  }
});

export const { setItems, setLoading } = featureSlice.actions;
export default featureSlice.reducer;

docs.title: 7. Create Components
docs.text:
Build React components in components/:

// components/FeatureList/index.tsx
import { useFeatures } from '../../hooks/useFeatureQueries';
import { FeatureCard } from './FeatureCard';

export function FeatureList() {
  const { data: features, isLoading, error } = useFeatures();

  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>Error: {error.message}</div>;

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      {features?.map(feature => (
        <FeatureCard key={feature.id} feature={feature} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

docs.title: 8. Write Tests
docs.text:
Create tests in __tests__/:

// __tests__/components/FeatureList.test.tsx
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import { FeatureList } from '../components/FeatureList';

describe('FeatureList', () => {
  it('renders features', async () => {
    render(<FeatureList />);

    expect(await screen.findByText('Feature 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

docs.title: 9. Export Public API
docs.text:
Define exports in index.ts:

// Components
export { FeatureList } from './components/FeatureList';
export { FeatureDetail } from './components/FeatureDetail';

// Hooks
export { useFeatures, useCreateFeature } from './hooks/useFeatureQueries';

// Types
export type { Feature, FeatureState } from './types';

// Store (if using Redux)
export { featureSlice } from './store/featureSlice';

docs.title: 10. Create Page Component
docs.text:
Create a thin page component in /src/pages/[feature]/:

import { FeatureList } from '@/features/[feature-name]';
import { PageLayout } from '@/shared/components/layout/PageLayout';

export default function FeaturePage() {
  return (
    <PageLayout title="Features">
      <FeatureList />
    </PageLayout>
  );
}

docs.title: 1. Keep Features Independent
docs.text:
• Minimize dependencies between features
  • Use events or shared state for cross-feature communication
  • Import from feature's public API (index.ts) only

docs.title: 2. Co-locate Related Code
docs.text:
• Keep components, hooks, and tests close to where they're used
  • Use nested folders for complex components
  • Group related utilities together

docs.title: 3. Use TypeScript Strictly
docs.text:
• Define all types explicitly
  • Avoid any types
  • Use discriminated unions for complex states

docs.title: 4. Test Everything
docs.text:
• Write tests before implementation (TDD)
  • Test components, hooks, and utilities
  • Maintain 100% coverage

docs.title: 5. Document as You Go
docs.text:
• Add JSDoc comments to complex functions
  • Update feature documentation
  • Include examples in comments

docs.title: Contact Submissions Inbox System - Database Schema Design
Overview
docs.text: This document outlines the comprehensive database schema design for a contact submissions inbox system with advanced ticket management functionality. The system integrates seamlessly with the existing Nelson Tech platform architecture, leveraging existing authentication, member management, and audit infrastructure.

docs.title: Existing System Integration
docs.text:
• Authentication: Leverages Supabase auth.users table for admin user management
  • Member System: Links to existing public.members table for automatic member identification
  • Role System: Utilizes existing public.user_roles for permission management
  • Audit Infrastructure: Integrates with existing audit logging patterns

docs.title: Core Design Principles
docs.text:
1. Privacy-First: Submissions are private by default with strict RLS policies
  2. Audit Trail: Complete history tracking for compliance and accountability
  3. Scalability: Optimized indexes and efficient query patterns
  4. Flexibility: Tag-based categorization with extensible metadata
  5. Integration-Ready: Designed to work with email services and automation

docs.title: contact_submissions (Primary Table)
docs.text:
The central table storing all contact form submissions with comprehensive ticket management.

Contact Data Fields: - name (TEXT, NOT NULL): Submitter's full name - email (TEXT, NOT NULL): Contact email address - phone (TEXT): Optional phone number - subject (TEXT, NOT NULL): Subject line of inquiry - message (TEXT, NOT NULL): Full message content - organization (TEXT): Company/organization if provided

Ticket Management Fields: - status (ENUM): 'open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'closed', 'spam' - priority (ENUM): 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent' - assigned_to (UUID): References auth.users(id) for assignment - category (TEXT): Broad categorization (e.g., 'support', 'partnership') - tags (TEXT[]): Flexible tagging system for detailed categorization

Member Integration: - member_id (UUID): Auto-linked to public.members if email matches registered user

Audit Trail: - created_at, updated_at: Standard timestamps - resolved_at, closed_at: Status-specific timestamps - assigned_at, assigned_by: Assignment tracking

Metadata: - source: How submission was received ('contact_form', 'email', 'chat') - ip_address, user_agent, referrer: Request metadata - internal_notes: Private admin notes

Response Tracking: - response_sent, response_sent_at, response_sent_by: Email response tracking - auto_response_sent: Auto-response flag - follow_up_required, follow_up_date: Follow-up management

docs.title: contact_submission_tags (Tag Management)
docs.text:
Predefined tags for consistent categorization.

Fields: - name, slug: Human-readable and URL-safe identifiers - description: Tag explanation - color: Hex color for UI display - is_system: Distinguishes system vs user-created tags - category: Groups related tags together

Default System Tags: - General Inquiry, Membership, Partnership, Support - Event Inquiry, Media Request, Bug Report, Feature Request - Spam, Urgent (priority markers)

docs.title: contact_submission_history (Audit Trail)
docs.text:
Complete audit trail for all submission changes.

Change Tracking: - field_changed: Which field was modified - old_value, new_value: Before/after values - change_type: Categorized change types ('status_change', 'assignment', etc.) - changed_by, changed_at: Who and when - comment: Optional admin comment - automated: Flag for system-generated changes

docs.title: contact_submission_responses (Response Management)
docs.text:
Tracks all email responses sent to submitters.

Response Data: - subject, body: Email content - response_type: 'auto_response', 'manual_response', 'follow_up' - sent_by, sent_at: Delivery tracking - delivery_status: Email delivery status - external_message_id: Integration with email services - template_used, template_data: Template system integration

docs.title: contact_submission_attachments (File Management)
docs.text:
Future-ready attachment handling.

File Data: - filename, original_filename: File identification - file_size, mime_type: File metadata - storage_path, storage_bucket: Storage location - Upload tracking and user association

import { useContactSubmissions } from '@/hooks/useContactSubmissions';

const AdminDashboard = () => {
  const { 
    submissions, 
    loading, 
    updateSubmission 
  } = useContactSubmissions({
    filters: { status: ['new', 'in_progress'] }
  });

  const handleStatusChange = (id, status) => {
    updateSubmission(id, { status });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {submissions.map(submission => (
        <SubmissionCard 
          key={submission.id}
          submission={submission}
          onStatusChange={handleStatusChange}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

docs.title: Feature Toggle Navigation Filter
docs.text:
// Dynamic navigation filtering
const filteredNavLinks = useMemo(() => {
  return navLinks.map(link => {
    // Check main link feature requirement
    if (link.feature && !isFeatureEnabled(link.feature)) {
      return null;
    }

    // Filter children based on feature requirements
    if (link.children) {
      const filteredChildren = link.children.filter(child => {
        return !child.feature || isFeatureEnabled(child.feature);
      });

      // Hide parent if no children remain
      if (filteredChildren.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }

      return { ...link, children: filteredChildren };
    }

    return link;
  }).filter(Boolean);
}, [navLinks, isFeatureEnabled]);

// ❌ Old Pattern - Everything in Redux
interface EventsState {
  events: Event[];           // ❌ Server data in Redux
  currentEvent: Event;       // ❌ Server data in Redux
  isLoading: boolean;        // ❌ API state in Redux
  error: string | null;      // ❌ API state in Redux
  filters: EventFilters;     // ✅ UI state (correct)
}

// Manual async thunks for every operation
export const fetchEvents = createAsyncThunk(/*...*/);
export const fetchEventById = createAsyncThunk(/*...*/);
export const createEvent = createAsyncThunk(/*...*/);

// Usage required manual fetching

useEffect(() => {

docs.title: After: Hybrid Pattern
docs.text:
// ✅ New Pattern - Separated Concerns

// Redux UI Slice (UI state only)
interface EventsUIState {
  filters: EventFilters;     // ✅ UI state
  selectedEvents: string[];  // ✅ UI state
  viewMode: 'list' | 'calendar'; // ✅ UI state
  sortBy: string;           // ✅ UI state
  pagination: PaginationState; // ✅ UI state
}

// React Query (Server state only)
export const useEvents = () => useQuery({
  queryKey: ['events'],
  queryFn: eventsApi.getAll,
  staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
});

export const useCreateEvent = () => useMutation({
  mutationFn: eventsApi.create,
  onSuccess: () => {
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] });
  },
});

// Hybrid Hook (Integration layer)
export function useEventsHybrid() {
  const filters = useAppSelector(selectEventsFilters);
  const eventsQuery = useEventsWithFilters(filters);

  return {
    // Server data from React Query
    events: eventsQuery.data || [],
    isLoading: eventsQuery.isLoading,

    // UI state from Redux
    filters,

    // Actions
    setSearchTerm: (search) => dispatch(updateFilters({ search })),
  };
}

// Usage is automatic - no manual fetching!
const { events, isLoading, setSearchTerm } = useEventsHybrid();

// src/config/queryClient.ts
export const createQueryClient = () => new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes

      refetchOnWindowFocus: (query) => {

docs.title: Database Schema
docs.text:
CREATE TABLE pages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  content TEXT,
  excerpt TEXT,
  hero_image TEXT,
  author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' 
    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published', 'archived')),
  meta_title VARCHAR(255),
  meta_description TEXT,
  is_featured BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Performance indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_slug ON pages(slug);
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_status ON pages(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_author ON pages(author_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_published ON pages(published_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_pages_featured ON pages(is_featured);

-- Row Level Security policies
CREATE POLICY pages_public_read ON pages 
  FOR SELECT USING (status = 'published');

CREATE POLICY pages_author_all ON pages 
  FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = author_id);

CREATE POLICY pages_admin_all ON pages 
  FOR ALL USING (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur 
      WHERE ur.user_id = auth.uid() 
      AND ur.role IN ('admin', 'superadmin')
    )
  );

const ProfilePublisher: React.FC = () => {
  const [isPublishing, setIsPublishing] = useState(false);
  const { member } = useCurrentMember();

  const handlePublish = async () => {
    setIsPublishing(true);
    try {
      await publishProfile(member.id);
      toast.success('Your profile is now visible in the directory!');
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to publish profile');
    } finally {
      setIsPublishing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <ProfilePreview member={member} />

      <Button
        onClick={handlePublish}
        loading={isPublishing}
        variant="primary"
      >
        Publish to Directory
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
};

docs.title: 1. Main Onboarding Flow Controller
docs.text:
FUNCTION initializeOnboarding(userId):
    // Check if user has already completed onboarding
    user = getUserProfile(userId)

    IF user.onboarding_completed_at IS NOT NULL:
        REDIRECT to dashboard
        RETURN

    // Initialize or restore onboarding session
    session = getOnboardingSession(userId)

    IF session IS NULL:
        session = createOnboardingSession(userId)
        session.currentStep = 1
        session.completedSteps = []
        session.skippedSteps = []
        session.startedAt = NOW()

    // Load user's progress
    progress = calculateProgress(session)

    // Navigate to current step
    DISPLAY OnboardingWizard(session, progress)
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION calculateProgress(session):
    totalSteps = 5
    mandatorySteps = [1, 3] // Welcome and Privacy
    completedMandatory = COUNT(session.completedSteps INTERSECT mandatorySteps)
    completedOptional = COUNT(session.completedSteps) - completedMandatory

    progress = {
        percentage: (COUNT(session.completedSteps) / totalSteps) * 100,
        currentStep: session.currentStep,
        mandatoryComplete: completedMandatory == LENGTH(mandatorySteps),
        canFinish: progress.mandatoryComplete,
        stepsRemaining: totalSteps - COUNT(session.completedSteps)
    }

    RETURN progress
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 2. Step Navigation Logic
docs.text:
FUNCTION navigateToStep(userId, targetStep, currentData):
    session = getOnboardingSession(userId)

    // Save current step data if moving forward
    IF targetStep > session.currentStep:
        saveStepData(userId, session.currentStep, currentData)

        // Validate mandatory fields
        IF NOT validateStep(session.currentStep, currentData):
            RETURN {success: false, errors: getValidationErrors()}

        // Mark step as completed
        ADD session.currentStep TO session.completedSteps

    // Handle skip action
    ELSE IF targetStep == SKIP_STEP:
        IF session.currentStep NOT IN mandatorySteps:
            ADD session.currentStep TO session.skippedSteps
            targetStep = getNextStep(session.currentStep)
        ELSE:
            RETURN {success: false, error: "Cannot skip mandatory step"}

    // Update session
    session.currentStep = targetStep
    saveOnboardingSession(session)

    // Load step data
    stepData = loadStepData(userId, targetStep)

    RETURN {
        success: true,
        step: targetStep,
        data: stepData,
        progress: calculateProgress(session)
    }
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION getNextStep(currentStep):
    steps = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    currentIndex = INDEXOF(steps, currentStep)

    IF currentIndex < LENGTH(steps) - 1:
        RETURN steps[currentIndex + 1]
    ELSE:
        RETURN COMPLETION_STEP
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 3.1 Welcome & Basic Profile (Step 1)
docs.text:
FUNCTION processWelcomeStep(userId, formData):
    // Validate required fields
    VALIDATE formData.name IS NOT EMPTY
    VALIDATE formData.title IS NOT EMPTY
    VALIDATE formData.location IS NOT EMPTY

    // Process profile photo if provided
    IF formData.profilePhoto:
        photoUrl = uploadProfilePhoto(userId, formData.profilePhoto)
        formData.photoUrl = photoUrl

    // Update user profile
    UPDATE members SET
        name = formData.name,
        title = formData.title,
        location = formData.location,
        image = formData.photoUrl,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = userId

    // Log analytics event
    trackEvent('onboarding_step_completed', {
        userId: userId,
        step: 1,
        stepName: 'welcome_basic_profile'
    })

    RETURN {success: true}
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 3.2 Professional Information (Step 2)
docs.text:
FUNCTION processProfessionalInfo(userId, formData):
    // Process bio with sanitization
    bio = sanitizeRichText(formData.bio)

    // Validate skills
    IF LENGTH(formData.skills) > 20:
        RETURN {success: false, error: "Maximum 20 skills allowed"}

    // Start transaction
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
        // Update member profile
        UPDATE members SET
            bio = bio,
            employment_status = formData.employmentStatus,
            years_experience = formData.yearsExperience,
            open_to_volunteering = formData.openToVolunteering,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE user_id = userId

        // Update skills (replace existing)
        DELETE FROM member_skills WHERE member_id = userId

        FOR EACH skill IN formData.skills:
            INSERT INTO member_skills (member_id, skill_name, skill_level)
            VALUES (userId, skill.name, skill.level)

        // Update profile completion
        completion = calculateProfileCompletion(userId)
        UPDATE members SET 
            profile_completion_percentage = completion
        WHERE user_id = userId
    COMMIT TRANSACTION

    RETURN {success: true, completion: completion}
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 3.3 Privacy & Visibility Controls (Step 3)
docs.text:
FUNCTION processPrivacySettings(userId, formData):
    // Define privacy schema
    privacySettings = {
        profileVisibility: formData.profileVisibility, // public|members_only|private
        showEmail: formData.showEmail,
        showPhone: formData.showPhone,
        allowMessages: formData.allowMessages,
        allowNetworkingRequests: formData.allowNetworkingRequests,
        emailNotifications: {
            newsletters: formData.newsletters,
            eventInvites: formData.eventInvites,
            messageAlerts: formData.messageAlerts,
            groupUpdates: formData.groupUpdates
        }
    }

    // Validate visibility settings
    IF privacySettings.profileVisibility == 'private':
        privacySettings.showEmail = false
        privacySettings.showPhone = false
        privacySettings.allowMessages = false

    // Update member privacy settings
    UPDATE members SET
        privacy_settings = privacySettings,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = userId

    // Update notification preferences
    upsertNotificationPreferences(userId, privacySettings.emailNotifications)

    RETURN {success: true}
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 3.4 Company Association (Step 4)
docs.text:
FUNCTION processCompanyAssociation(userId, formData):
    IF formData.action == 'join_existing':
        RETURN joinExistingCompany(userId, formData)
    ELSE IF formData.action == 'create_new':
        RETURN createNewCompany(userId, formData)
    ELSE IF formData.action == 'skip':
        RETURN {success: true, skipped: true}

END FUNCTION

FUNCTION joinExistingCompany(userId, formData):
    company = getCompanyById(formData.companyId)

    IF company IS NULL:
        RETURN {success: false, error: "Company not found"}

    // Check if already an employee
    existing = getCompanyEmployee(formData.companyId, userId)
    IF existing:
        RETURN {success: false, error: "Already associated with this company"}

    // Create employee association
    IF formData.verificationMethod == 'email_domain':
        userEmail = getUserEmail(userId)
        companyDomain = extractDomain(company.email)
        userDomain = extractDomain(userEmail)

        IF userDomain != companyDomain:
            // Send verification request
            sendCompanyVerificationRequest(company.id, userId, formData)
            RETURN {success: true, pending: true}

    // Direct association (if allowed)
    IF company.allow_direct_join:
        INSERT INTO company_employees (
            company_id, user_id, role, department, 
            start_date, is_verified, added_by
        ) VALUES (
            company.id, userId, formData.role, formData.department,
            NOW(), true, 'self_onboarding'
        )

        // Grant employee role
        grantRole(userId, 'company_employee')

        RETURN {success: true, joined: true}

    RETURN {success: false, error: "Company requires admin approval"}
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION createNewCompany(userId, formData):
    // Validate company data
    VALIDATE formData.companyName LENGTH >= 2
    VALIDATE formData.companyEmail IS VALID EMAIL
    VALIDATE formData.industry IS NOT EMPTY

    // Check for duplicates
    existing = findCompanyByNameOrEmail(formData.companyName, formData.companyEmail)
    IF existing:
        RETURN {success: false, error: "Company already exists", existingId: existing.id}

    BEGIN TRANSACTION
        // Create company
        company = INSERT INTO companies (
            name, email, website, industry, size,
            description, location, created_by, status
        ) VALUES (
            formData.companyName, formData.companyEmail,
            formData.website, formData.industry, formData.size,
            formData.description, formData.location,
            userId, 'pending_verification'
        ) RETURNING *

        // Process logo if provided
        IF formData.logo:
            logoUrl = uploadCompanyLogo(company.id, formData.logo)
            UPDATE companies SET logo = logoUrl WHERE id = company.id

        // Add creator as admin employee
        INSERT INTO company_employees (
            company_id, user_id, role, department,
            start_date, is_verified, is_admin
        ) VALUES (
            company.id, userId, 'Founder', 'Leadership',
            NOW(), true, true
        )

        // Grant company admin role
        grantRole(userId, 'company_admin')

        // Send verification email
        sendCompanyVerificationEmail(company, userId)
    COMMIT TRANSACTION

    RETURN {success: true, companyId: company.id}
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 3.5 Community Engagement (Step 5)
docs.text:
FUNCTION processCommunityEngagement(userId, formData):
    BEGIN TRANSACTION
        // Update member interests
        DELETE FROM member_interests WHERE member_id = userId

        FOR EACH interest IN formData.interests:
            INSERT INTO member_interests (member_id, interest_name, interest_level)
            VALUES (userId, interest.name, interest.level)

        // Process group memberships
        FOR EACH groupId IN formData.joinGroups:
            joinGroup(userId, groupId)

        // Update member preferences
        UPDATE members SET
            mentorship_available_as = formData.mentorshipRole, // mentor|mentee|both|none
            networking_available = formData.networkingAvailable,
            volunteering_interests = formData.volunteeringInterests,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE user_id = userId

        // Calculate matches and suggestions
        suggestedConnections = findSuggestedConnections(userId, formData.interests)
        suggestedGroups = findSuggestedGroups(userId, formData.interests)
        suggestedEvents = findUpcomingEvents(formData.interests)

        // Store suggestions for dashboard
        storeSuggestions(userId, {
            connections: suggestedConnections,
            groups: suggestedGroups,
            events: suggestedEvents
        })
    COMMIT TRANSACTION

    RETURN {
        success: true,
        suggestions: {
            connectionsCount: LENGTH(suggestedConnections),
            groupsCount: LENGTH(suggestedGroups),
            eventsCount: LENGTH(suggestedEvents)
        }
    }
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 4. Completion and Post-Onboarding
docs.text:
FUNCTION completeOnboarding(userId):
    session = getOnboardingSession(userId)

    // Verify mandatory steps completed
    mandatorySteps = [1, 3]
    FOR EACH step IN mandatorySteps:
        IF step NOT IN session.completedSteps:
            RETURN {success: false, error: "Mandatory steps not completed"}

    // Calculate final profile completion
    completion = calculateProfileCompletion(userId)

    // Update member record
    UPDATE members SET
        onboarding_completed_at = NOW(),
        onboarding_current_step = NULL,
        profile_completion_percentage = completion,
        status = 'published' // Make profile visible
    WHERE user_id = userId

    // Grant roles based on completion
    IF completion >= 80:
        grantRole(userId, 'active_member')

    // Send welcome email
    sendWelcomeEmail(userId, {
        profileCompletion: completion,
        nextSteps: getRecommendedNextSteps(userId)
    })

    // Log completion analytics
    trackEvent('onboarding_completed', {
        userId: userId,
        completionTime: NOW() - session.startedAt,
        skippedSteps: session.skippedSteps,
        profileCompletion: completion
    })

    // Clean up session
    deleteOnboardingSession(userId)

    RETURN {
        success: true,
        redirectTo: '/dashboard/welcome',
        profileCompletion: completion
    }
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 5. Helper Functions
docs.text:
FUNCTION calculateProfileCompletion(userId):
    weights = {
        basicInfo: 20,      // name, title, location, photo
        professional: 25,   // bio, skills, employment
        contact: 10,        // email, phone, social links
        interests: 15,      // interests, groups joined
        company: 15,        // company association
        engagement: 15      // volunteering, mentorship, networking
    }

    scores = {
        basicInfo: scoreBasicInfo(userId),
        professional: scoreProfessional(userId),
        contact: scoreContact(userId),
        interests: scoreInterests(userId),
        company: scoreCompany(userId),
        engagement: scoreEngagement(userId)
    }

    totalScore = 0
    FOR EACH category, weight IN weights:
        totalScore += scores[category] * weight / 100

    RETURN ROUND(totalScore)
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION validateStep(stepNumber, data):
    validators = {
        1: validateBasicProfile,
        2: validateProfessionalInfo,
        3: validatePrivacySettings,
        4: validateCompanyAssociation,
        5: validateCommunityEngagement
    }

    validator = validators[stepNumber]
    RETURN validator(data)
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION uploadProfilePhoto(userId, photoFile):
    // Validate file
    IF photoFile.size > 5MB:
        THROW "File too large"

    IF photoFile.type NOT IN ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']:
        THROW "Invalid file type"

    // Process image
    processed = resizeAndOptimizeImage(photoFile, {
        maxWidth: 800,
        maxHeight: 800,
        quality: 0.85
    })

    // Generate unique filename
    filename = generateUniqueFilename(userId, 'profile', photoFile.extension)

    // Upload to storage
    url = uploadToStorage('profiles', filename, processed)

    RETURN url
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 6. Error Recovery & State Management
docs.text:
FUNCTION autoSaveProgress(userId, stepNumber, formData):
    // Debounce to avoid too many saves
    DEBOUNCE 1000ms

    // Save to temporary storage
    key = `onboarding_${userId}_step_${stepNumber}`
    saveToCache(key, {
        data: formData,
        timestamp: NOW(),
        version: 1
    }, TTL = 24 hours)

    RETURN {saved: true}
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION recoverProgress(userId, stepNumber):
    key = `onboarding_${userId}_step_${stepNumber}`
    cached = getFromCache(key)

    IF cached AND cached.timestamp > (NOW() - 24 hours):
        RETURN cached.data

    // Fallback to database
    saved = getStepDataFromDB(userId, stepNumber)
    RETURN saved OR {}
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION handleOnboardingError(error, context):
    // Log error with context
    logError('onboarding_error', {
        error: error,
        userId: context.userId,
        step: context.step,
        timestamp: NOW()
    })

    // Determine error type and response
    IF error.type == 'VALIDATION':
        RETURN {
            retry: true,
            message: error.message,
            fields: error.fields
        }
    ELSE IF error.type == 'NETWORK':
        RETURN {
            retry: true,
            message: "Connection issue. Your progress has been saved.",
            autoRetry: true
        }
    ELSE:
        RETURN {
            retry: false,
            message: "An error occurred. Please contact support.",
            supportTicket: createSupportTicket(error, context)
        }
END FUNCTION

docs.title: 2.6.3 Progress Calculator
docs.text:
Purpose: Calculate completion metrics.

// progressCalculator.ts
export class ProgressCalculator {
  static calculateOverallProgress(completedSteps: number[], totalSteps: number): number {
    return (completedSteps.length / totalSteps) * 100;
  }

  static calculateFieldProgress(fields: FieldCompletion[]): number {
    const completed = fields.filter(f => f.completed).length;
    return (completed / fields.length) * 100;
  }

  static calculateWeightedProgress(sections: SectionProgress[]): number {
    const totalWeight = sections.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.weight, 0);
    const weightedSum = sections.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (s.completion * s.weight), 0);
    return (weightedSum / totalWeight);
  }

  static getProfileCompletionLevel(percentage: number): CompletionLevel {
    if (percentage >= 90) return 'excellent';
    if (percentage >= 70) return 'good';
    if (percentage >= 50) return 'fair';
    return 'incomplete';
  }
}

docs.title: User Onboarding System - Testing Strategy & TDD Anchors
Overview
docs.text: This document outlines the comprehensive testing strategy for the user onboarding system using Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles. Each test is designed to be written before the implementation, following the Red-Green-Refactor cycle.

// OnboardingWizard.test.tsx
describe('OnboardingWizard', () => {
  describe('Initialization', () => {
    it('should load existing session for returning user', async () => {
      // Given: A user with an existing onboarding session
      const mockSession = {
        userId: 'user-123',
        currentStep: 3,
        completedSteps: [1, 2],
        skippedSteps: [],
      };
      mockGetSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);

      // When: The wizard is rendered
      const { getByTestId } = render(<OnboardingWizard userId="user-123" />);

      // Then: It should display the current step
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(getByTestId('current-step')).toHaveTextContent('Step 3');
      });
    });

    it('should create new session for first-time user', async () => {
      // Given: A new user with no existing session
      mockGetSession.mockResolvedValue(null);

      // When: The wizard is rendered
      render(<OnboardingWizard userId="new-user" />);

      // Then: It should create a new session
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockCreateSession).toHaveBeenCalledWith('new-user');
      });
    });

    it('should redirect if onboarding is already completed', async () => {
      // Given: A user who has completed onboarding
      const mockUser = { onboarding_completed_at: '2024-01-01' };
      mockGetUserProfile.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);

      // When: The wizard is rendered
      render(<OnboardingWizard userId="user-123" />);

      // Then: It should redirect to dashboard
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/dashboard');
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Navigation', () => {
    it('should not allow skipping mandatory steps', async () => {
      // Given: User is on mandatory step 1
      const { getByTestId } = render(
        <OnboardingWizard userId="user-123" />
      );

      // When: User tries to skip
      const skipButton = getByTestId('skip-button');
      fireEvent.click(skipButton);

      // Then: Should show error and not progress
      expect(getByTestId('error-message')).toHaveTextContent(
        'This step is required'
      );
    });

    it('should save progress when navigating forward', async () => {
      // Given: User completes step 1
      const { getByTestId } = render(
        <OnboardingWizard userId="user-123" />
      );

      fillBasicInfoForm();

      // When: User clicks next
      fireEvent.click(getByTestId('next-button'));

      // Then: Should save step data
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(mockSaveStepData).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
          'user-123',
          1,
          expect.objectContaining({
            name: 'John Doe',
            title: 'Developer',
            location: 'Vancouver',
          })
        );
      });
    });

    it('should allow backward navigation without saving', async () => {
      // Given: User is on step 3
      const { getByTestId } = render(
        <OnboardingWizard userId="user-123" initialStep={3} />
      );

      // When: User clicks back
      fireEvent.click(getByTestId('back-button'));

      // Then: Should go to step 2 without saving
      expect(getByTestId('current-step')).toHaveTextContent('Step 2');
      expect(mockSaveStepData).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('Progress Tracking', () => {
    it('should calculate progress correctly', async () => {
      // Given: User has completed 2 of 5 steps
      const { getByTestId } = render(
        <OnboardingWizard 
          userId="user-123" 
          completedSteps={[1, 2]}
        />
      );

      // Then: Progress should be 40%
      expect(getByTestId('progress-bar')).toHaveAttribute(
        'aria-valuenow',
        '40'
      );
    });

    it('should show completion available when mandatory steps done', async () => {
      // Given: User completed mandatory steps (1, 3)
      const { getByTestId } = render(
        <OnboardingWizard 
          userId="user-123" 
          completedSteps={[1, 3]}
        />
      );

      // Then: Complete button should be enabled
      expect(getByTestId('complete-button')).not.toBeDisabled();
    });
  });
});

// WelcomeStep.test.tsx
describe('WelcomeStep', () => {
  describe('Form Validation', () => {
    it('should require all mandatory fields', async () => {
      // Given: An empty form
      const onNext = jest.fn();
      const { getByTestId } = render(
        <WelcomeStep userData={{}} onNext={onNext} />
      );

      // When: User tries to submit without filling fields
      fireEvent.click(getByTestId('next-button'));

      // Then: Should show validation errors
      expect(getByTestId('name-error')).toHaveTextContent('Name is required');
      expect(getByTestId('title-error')).toHaveTextContent('Title is required');
      expect(getByTestId('location-error')).toHaveTextContent('Location is required');
      expect(onNext).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should validate name length', async () => {
      // Given: A form with very short name
      const { getByLabelText, getByTestId } = render(
        <WelcomeStep userData={{}} onNext={jest.fn()} />
      );

      // When: User enters single character name
      fireEvent.change(getByLabelText('Name'), { 
        target: { value: 'A' } 
      });
      fireEvent.click(getByTestId('next-button'));

      // Then: Should show length error
      expect(getByTestId('name-error')).toHaveTextContent(
        'Name must be at least 2 characters'
      );
    });
  });

  describe('Photo Upload', () => {
    it('should accept valid image files', async () => {
      // Given: A valid image file
      const file = new File(['image'], 'photo.jpg', { 
        type: 'image/jpeg' 
      });
      const { getByLabelText } = render(
        <WelcomeStep userData={{}} onNext={jest.fn()} />
      );

      // When: User uploads the file
      const input = getByLabelText('Profile Photo');
      fireEvent.change(input, { target: { files: [file] } });

      // Then: Should show preview
      await waitFor(() => {
        expect(getByTestId('photo-preview')).toBeInTheDocument();
      });
    });

    it('should reject files over 5MB', async () => {
      // Given: A large file
      const largeFile = new File(['x'.repeat(6 * 1024 * 1024)], 'large.jpg', {
        type: 'image/jpeg'
      });
      const { getByLabelText, getByTestId } = render(
        <WelcomeStep userData={{}} onNext={jest.fn()} />
      );

      // When: User uploads the large file
      const input = getByLabelText('Profile Photo');
      fireEvent.change(input, { target: { files: [largeFile] } });

      // Then: Should show error
      expect(getByTestId('photo-error')).toHaveTextContent(
        'File size must be less than 5MB'
      );
    });

    it('should reject non-image files', async () => {
      // Given: A PDF file
      const pdfFile = new File(['pdf'], 'document.pdf', {
        type: 'application/pdf'
      });
      const { getByLabelText, getByTestId } = render(
        <WelcomeStep userData={{}} onNext={jest.fn()} />
      );

      // When: User uploads the PDF
      const input = getByLabelText('Profile Photo');
      fireEvent.change(input, { target: { files: [pdfFile] } });

      // Then: Should show error
      expect(getByTestId('photo-error')).toHaveTextContent(
        'Please upload an image file (JPEG, PNG, or WebP)'
      );
    });
  });
});

// ProfessionalInfoStep.test.tsx
describe('ProfessionalInfoStep', () => {
  describe('Skills Selection', () => {
    it('should allow adding multiple skills', async () => {
      // Given: Skills selector
      const { getByLabelText, getByText, getAllByTestId } = render(
        <ProfessionalInfoStep userData={{}} onNext={jest.fn()} />
      );

      // When: User selects multiple skills
      const skillsInput = getByLabelText('Skills');
      fireEvent.change(skillsInput, { target: { value: 'React' } });
      fireEvent.click(getByText('Add'));
      fireEvent.change(skillsInput, { target: { value: 'TypeScript' } });
      fireEvent.click(getByText('Add'));

      // Then: Should display selected skills
      const skillTags = getAllByTestId('skill-tag');
      expect(skillTags).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(skillTags[0]).toHaveTextContent('React');
      expect(skillTags[1]).toHaveTextContent('TypeScript');
    });

    it('should limit skills to 20', async () => {
      // Given: User has added 20 skills
      const existingSkills = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `Skill ${i}`);
      const { getByLabelText, getByText } = render(
        <ProfessionalInfoStep 
          userData={{ skills: existingSkills }} 
          onNext={jest.fn()} 
        />
      );

      // When: User tries to add 21st skill
      const skillsInput = getByLabelText('Skills');
      fireEvent.change(skillsInput, { target: { value: 'Extra Skill' } });
      fireEvent.click(getByText('Add'));

      // Then: Should show error
      expect(getByTestId('skills-error')).toHaveTextContent(
        'Maximum 20 skills allowed'
      );
    });
  });

  describe('Bio Editor', () => {
    it('should sanitize HTML input', async () => {
      // Given: Bio editor with malicious HTML
      const onNext = jest.fn();
      const { getByLabelText, getByTestId } = render(
        <ProfessionalInfoStep userData={{}} onNext={onNext} />
      );

      // When: User enters HTML with script tag
      const bioEditor = getByLabelText('Bio');
      fireEvent.change(bioEditor, {
        target: { value: 'Hello <script>alert("xss")</script> World' }
      });
      fireEvent.click(getByTestId('next-button'));

      // Then: Should sanitize the input
      expect(onNext).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          bio: 'Hello  World'
        })
      );
    });
  });
});

// useOnboarding.test.ts
describe('useOnboarding', () => {
  it('should initialize onboarding for new user', async () => {
    // Given: A new user
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useOnboarding());

    // When: Initializing onboarding
    act(() => {
      result.current.initializeOnboarding('user-123');
    });

    // Then: Should create session and set initial state
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(result.current.currentStep).toBe(1);
      expect(result.current.progress.percentage).toBe(0);
      expect(result.current.isLoading).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  it('should handle step navigation', async () => {
    // Given: User on step 1
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useOnboarding());

    // When: Navigating to step 2
    act(() => {
      result.current.navigateToStep(2);
    });

    // Then: Should update current step
    expect(result.current.currentStep).toBe(2);
  });

  it('should validate before allowing completion', async () => {
    // Given: User has not completed mandatory steps
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useOnboarding());

    // Then: Should not allow completion
    expect(result.current.canComplete).toBe(false);
  });
});

// useStepValidation.test.ts
describe('useStepValidation', () => {
  it('should validate step 1 data', async () => {
    // Given: Step 1 validation hook
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useStepValidation(1));

    // When: Validating incomplete data
    const isValid = await result.current.validate({
      name: '',
      title: 'Developer',
      location: 'Vancouver'
    });

    // Then: Should return false with errors
    expect(isValid).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.errors).toContainEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({
        field: 'name',
        message: 'Name is required'
      })
    );
  });

  it('should clear errors', async () => {
    // Given: Hook with errors
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useStepValidation(1));
    await result.current.validate({ name: '' });

    // When: Clearing errors
    act(() => {
      result.current.clearErrors();
    });

    // Then: Should have no errors
    expect(result.current.errors).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(result.current.hasErrors).toBe(false);
  });
});
